programme.title: Tomiris
programme.desc: Tomiris, kraljica Amazonki, povela je 600 godina pre nove ere krvavi rat protiv Persijskog carstva. Kada persijski kralj Kir uništi njeno selo, ona okuplja ogromnu vojsku da oslobodi svoj narod. Slede spektakularne bitke, borbe na život i smrt i spletke surovog kralja koji silom i prevarama želi da pokori narod.

programme.title: Njuškalo u ratu
programme.desc: Nakon što su mu roditelji poginuli u bombardovanju tokom Drugog svetskog rata, Tomas u poslali da živi s rođacima na seoskoj farmi u Holandiji. On je tužan, ljut i uplašen i prezire što mora da živi sa tetkom i tečom.Ali kad Tom dobije da gaju nemačkog ovčara Njuškala, sve se iz korena menja. On sve svoje poverenje poklanja Njuškalu i zajedno se trude da izvuku najbolje od života iako je njihovo selo pod nemačkom kontrolom.Uz Njuškalovu pomoć Tom spasava holandskog pilota koji je oboren i ranjen. Ali kada holandski nacistički kolaboracionista pošalje vojnike da traže pilota, na Njuškalu i Tomu je da razotkriju izdajnika. Pilot uspeva da pobegne u svoju jedinicu, a Njuškalo nazad dovodi vojsku kako bi oslobodili grad."Njuškalo u ratu" je dostupno u dve verzije, kao dugometražni igrani film ili kao mini-serija od četiri polučasovne epizode.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se da održi svoju poslastičarnicu, ali jednog dana izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora primorava je da zatvori posao. Meri sa svojim verenikom Brentom odlučuje da otputuje kod svoje porodice u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću, Brent dobija napad alergije koji ga sprečava da krene na put. Meri odlučuje da sa sobom povede Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca, koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora, i predstavi ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to biti dobra ideja?

programme.title: Pravo mesto i vreme za pisanje
programme.desc: Paigeina majka želi da kći krene njenim stopama i preuzme vođenje velikog konglomerata, no Paige želi biti spisateljica. Kada Joan odluči prodati izdavačku kuću Atlas zbog manjka klijenata i prihoda, Paige to vidi kao priliku da joj pruži posljednju šansu — ovaj put pišući pod pseudonimom, tako da nitko, pa ni Daniel, posljednja nada izdavača, ne zna da upravo njena obitelj predstavlja prijetnju.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Ljubavni brodolom
programme.desc: Tokom krstarenja Karibima, Dženi ostaje nasukana na obali sa svojim rokenrol idolom. Očarana idejom da će neko vreme provesti nasamo s njim, uspeva da sakrije činjenicu da se nalaze na samo nekoliko koraka od svog odmarališta.

programme.title: Božićni izazov
programme.desc: Voditeljka podkasta Lora Ros i njen dugogodišnji prijatelj i producent Pol, suočeni su sa preispitivanjem svog ličnog i profesionalnog odnosa. Sve počinje kada slušalac njihovog ambicioznog podkasta "Moderni i nezavisni" predloži dnevne "Božićne izazove" koji promovišu zajedništvo.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Nakon promena u rukovodstvu, Do-jong preuzima vlast, a posledice ranijih postupaka menjaju živote svih umešanih.

programme.title: Niko nije anđeo
programme.desc: Trudnica koja beži od momka nasilnika, ukrcava se u voz, a štiti je upravo venčan bračni par. Kada se voz slupa, mladenci ginu, a identitet trudne devojke zamenjen je s pokojnom mladom, jer je u trenutku sudara nosila njenu burmu.

programme.title: Zaljubljeni u Njujorku
programme.desc: Posle strastvene avanture za jednu noć, dvoje njujorških milenijalaca sastavlja ugovor o vezi bez obaveza kako bi izbegli zamke prethodnih ljubavnih odnosa.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: A dim-witted busboy finds acclaim as an artist for a plaster-covered dead cat that is mistaken as a skillful statuette. The desire for more praise soon leads to an increasingly deadly series of works.

programme.title: Roaring Abyss
programme.desc: A sound journey accros the mountains, deserts and forests of Ethiopia and its cultural universe. Roaring Abyss will take you through an inedit collection of music recordings of unvaluable importance for the transmission and preservation of the African heritage.

programme.title: The Admiral Was a Lady
programme.desc: Ex-WAVE encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.

programme.title: Quality Time
programme.desc: Five thirty-something men in as many separate segments struggle to grapple with the relentless absurdity of their respective existences.

programme.title: Fabiu
programme.desc: 80-year-old retiree Arthur lives in a modest council home in Vienna. For quite some time he has lovingly been caring for his seriously ill wife Martha, with only female nurses assisting him. As he finds Fabiu, the new male hungarian care worker, on his doorstep, his routine is broken. But soon the two men become closer and inside Arthur feelings of desire and suppressed longing start to rise.

programme.title: Seven Chances
programme.desc: A man learns he will inherit a fortune if he marries by 7 p.m. that same day.

programme.title: Bella Vista
programme.desc: A film about place and belonging.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Secret Police
programme.desc: Captain Drummond and his girlfriend want to marry but a hidden treasure in the house in which they want to celebrate their marriage is complicating the situation involving a series of deaths and an elusive murderer.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Call the Mesquiteers
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers are forced to track down a train robbery ring after some of the gang hijack their truck for a getaway and the police conclude they are part of the gang, an identification which is just fine with the gang's nameless chief.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.title: The Navigator
programme.desc: The wealthy and impulsive Rollo Treadway decides to propose to his beautiful socialite neighbor, Betsy O'Brien. Although Betsy turns Rollo down, he still opts to go on the cruise that he intended as their honeymoon.

programme.title: Wake Me When the War Is Over
programme.desc: During the final months of WW2, a lonely German Baroness hides an attractive American airman in her mansion for long time without telling him the war has been over for almost five years.

programme.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
programme.desc: Swordsman-poet helps soldier woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

programme.title: Desert Storm
programme.desc: Chet Kasedon is after the Indians hidden gold mine but Chief Moya will not reveal it's location. He has also hired mining engineers Gale and Mortimer to locate the mine. When Gale sees Kasedon's cruelty to Moya, he switches sides.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Peril
programme.desc: Drummond's wedding with Phyllis is interrupted when the inspector guarding their gifts is killed. He tries to trace the killers and uncovers the mystery of diamond counterfeiters.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: The Sadist
programme.desc: Three people driving into Los Angeles for a Dodgers game have car trouble and pull off into an old wrecking yard where they are held at bay by a bloodthirsty psycho and his crazy girlfriend.

programme.title: Girl Gang
programme.desc: A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Stranger Within a Woman
programme.desc: Two friends meet in a bar. Later that night, one friend's flirtatious wife is reportedly in an accident. The other friend doesn't feel well. What's come over him?

programme.title: Sea Dragon
programme.desc: A young fossil hunter makes a groundbreaking discovery, challenging the worldview of 19th century England.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: Road Gate
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. They are separated by a toll-bar between wealth and poverty. One day Aidar and Rauan will clash and their worlds will clash. What will the results be..?

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Buck Colins heads a group of local ranchers who are trying to prevent the railroad from completing its line through their property. Till now they have been able to charge tolls on herds passing through. Hoppy goes undercover to expose them.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Due to a bet drunk Gene almost forces Majesty to marry him, then escapes after brawling with sheriff Tom. Majesty buys a ranch, needs Gene's help and finds him in a drunken stupor in Mexico. He vows to stay sober and fights crooked Tom.

programme.title: The Amazing Adventure
programme.desc: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

programme.title: Santa Fe Marshall
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Hopalong Cassidy is called when a town becomes overrun with bad guys. Disguised as a member of a medicine show, Hoppy discovers that the ringleader is none other than sweet li'l ol' Ma Burton.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: Horse Tales
programme.desc: Horse Tales tells the story of stable boys, adolescents making a living by taking care of horses. In order to do so, it focuses on their job and their relationships with the animals they care for.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: Voyage to the Prehistoric Planet
programme.desc: In 2020, after the colonization of the moon, the spaceships Vega, Sirius and Capella are launched from Lunar Station 7.

programme.title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
programme.desc: A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.

programme.title: The Driver's Seat
programme.desc: Lise, a mentally unbalanced middle-aged woman, travels from her home in Copenhagen to Rome, Italy where she embarks on a fatal destiny, a premeditated search for someone, anyone, with whom she can form a dangerous liaison.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
programme.desc: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental lord who oversees the trust.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island
programme.desc: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.

programme.title: Joan of Arkansas
programme.desc: When the U.S. Space program requires an ordinary person to become the first human in space, the Saraback Computer chooses Joan Jones, a scatter brained, good natured klutz who works as a dental technician.

programme.title: Lukas the Strange
programme.desc: Lukas Nino (Lukas the Strange) follows an awkward teenager facing his initiation into manhood as a film crew descends on his village. After being told his father is a tikbalang—half horse, half man—Lukas begins to question his own nature when his father disappears. As the village is swept up in movie fever, a legend emerges about a mystical river that erases painful memories. Narrated by Lukas' friend Lorena, the film blends myth, coming-of-age, and imagination.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: A man in a gleaming white suit comes to a small Southern town on the eve of integration. He calls himself a social reformer. But what he does is stir up trouble--trouble he soon finds he can't control.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Newly married Kay Dunstan announces that she and her husband are having a baby, leaving her father to come to grips with the fact that he will soon be a granddad.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: People We Know Are Confused
programme.desc: Set in Vilnius, a modern city still in search for its relation to the past, three parallel stories with three average people marooned in a state of change, looking to the future with hope, but not letting go of constricting and reassuring fears of their past.

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: It's a Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

programme.title: 30 Years and an Ocean in Between
programme.desc: Jaume, who was once a passionate young man, has become a disillusioned middle-aged man who has lost his desire to write and can't remember the last time he fell in love. On another boring summer day in Barcelona, he receives a surprise visit from Elisabeth, a romantic interest from the past. The encounter brings back the Jaume of yesterday, turning his monotonous life upside down.

programme.title: AUN: The Beginning and the End of All Things
programme.desc: When looking for alternative energy sources, the Japanese scientist Sekai tragically dies. Twenty years later the Brazilian mathematician Euclides continues his research. The lack of an essential component won't allow a breakthrough. Only AUN, Sekai's son, seems to hold the key to protect mankind from self-destruction. In the aftermath of the nuclear tragedy in Fukushima the film appears like a prophecy. AUN's dream-like images, complemented by music from Christian Fennesz and Ryuichi Sakamoto, lead into a fantastic and exciting world, full of brightness and darkness of life.

programme.title: Pride of the West
programme.desc: Caldwell and Nixon have their men rob the stage and then critcize the Sheriff for not catching the robbers. With her father the Sheriff under pressure, Mary sends for Hoppy who finds the stolen money and sets a trap to bring in the entire gang.

programme.desc: After reading an newspaper advertisement in the London Times about touring Canada, an elderly Englishman decides to do just that. Following his long walk across the Atlantic Ocean, Keaton travels along the Canadian National Railway tracks on a railway motorcar (speeder), performing a few stunts reminiscent of those in his younger days.

programme.desc: Ejmi i Tami loše započinju proces polaganja vozačkog ispita. Kris i Britani dobijaju neočekivane vesti, a Tami još nije spremna da oprosti Misti.

programme.title: Venčanica iz snova: Vegas
programme.desc: Samanti treba Dejvidova pomoć da pronađe venčanicu koja će joj pokriti tetovaže na grudima. Izbirljiva Dženi želi seksi haljinu koja će se uklopiti za prijem u noćnom klubu.

programme.title: Devedeset dana za venčanje
programme.desc: Omiljeni likovi iz serije iznose sočne komentare o drami i vrhuncima prethodne epizode _ bez zadrške, iz svog doma!

programme.title: Veridba od 90 dana: Život u braku
programme.desc: Jasmin čuva tajnu od Đina. Mahmud se sprema da ostavi sve što zna. Rob se brine da je Sofi sada s nekim drugim.

programme.title: Sestre od 500 kilograma
programme.desc: Ejmi se poslednji put suočava sa sudijom. Temi se obraća Ejmi zbog povećanja težine. Porodica putuje u Pitsburg na Taminu operaciju uklanjanja kože.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg
programme.desc: Posle pet godina u kolicima, Latonjina težina učinila ju je gotovo nepokretnom. Ona ne želi da se odrekne hrane, ali hoće li to učiniti zbog ljubavi?

programme.title: Sve žene mog muža
programme.desc: Džanel okuplja Kodija i njegove žene kako bi porazgovarali o tenziji koja se skuplja među njima. Robin i Kristin im poveravaju svoje nesigurnosti.

programme.title: Bejlin želi da je čuju
programme.desc: Bejlen i njena deveruša Semi se ne slažu oko planiranja zajedničkog momačko-devojačkog vikenda za Bejlen i Kolina.

programme.title: Bejlin želi da je čuju
programme.desc: Bejlen i Semi razgovaraju o Seminoj ulozi. Zabrinutost oko mesta venčanja navodi Bejlen na plan koji ugrožava taj dan.

programme.title: Šantel i njena porodica
programme.desc: Pedru je dosta Šantelinog osuđivanja njegove porodice. Alehandro traži savet od svoje tetke i moli Nikol da mu da drugu priliku.

programme.title: Šantel i njena porodica
programme.desc: Karen šalje River i Pedra da pronađu savršeno božićno drvce. Osim toga, Lidija govori Pedru o Nikolinoj odluci da se vrati sa Alehandrom.

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg

programme.title: Živeti sa 300 kg: Brazil
programme.desc: Andrea većinu vremena provodi ležeći u krevetu, sama, jedući. Bez daha i energije za aktivan život suočava se sa ozbiljnim zdravstvenim problemima.

programme.title: Najekstremniji ljudi
programme.desc: U Turskoj, najviša žena na svetu živi sa nepoznatim genetskim stanjem, dok se u Brazilu, najniži par na svetu bori sa patuljastim rastom.

programme.title: Preveliki
programme.desc: Nakon bolnog oporavka od barijatrijske operacije, Megan naporno radi da održi na pravom putu dijetu svoje najbolje prijateljice Vanese.

programme.title: Moj prelep život sa viškom kilograma
programme.desc: Nakon bliskog susreta sa bivšim dečkom, Vitni se pita da li je spremna da preboli Čejsa. Izbegla je karantin zbog zabavnog vikend putovanja sa prijateljima.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Forests are crucial for our survival on Earth. They absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and supply all living forms with clean oxygen. "We are like a patient in a hospital bed that is turning down their oxygen tank and thinking they could live with a little bit less oxygen and meanwhile the CO2 is increasing in the room" says journalist Andrew Nikiforuk.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died. It is believed most of the hauntings that occur here are from the very people that died here.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Team members Patricia Marin and Malinka Franklin help a lost soul cross over into the light.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: This episode of Desperate Hours is all about disasters at sea. The long saga of death and misadventure at sea is as much a record of human folly as it is of nature's fury. When you start charting a course through the choppy seas of maritime disasters, the effect can be quite sobering. From the loss of the Titanic, a supposedly unsinkable luxury liner; to a routine ferry trip in South Korea that ended with the heart-breaking loss of so many young lives. Or how about the Exxon Valdez oil spoil, which pumped millions of gallons of crude oil into Prince William Sound, Alaska, one of the last pristine environments on earth? Then there is the return of piracy to the high seas _ not as a masquerade, but as a clear and present danger. That old saying "worse things happen at sea"? Well, it turns out, they really do.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: And we're off! We learn the history of the world famous Kentucky Derby. Then, call your shot as we learn about one of America's most famous brands, Louisville Slugger. Also, we zip line in the world's only underground zip line attraction and visit the Ali Center.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: The Saints come marching in as we tour the iconic St. Louis Cathedral and the mysterious Ursuline Convent in New Orleans. We delve into Mardi Gras history at Mardi Gras World and visit the National WWII Museum's world class collection.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots. Around the campfire at night meet the local dance group who is preserving the traditional dances of the area people. A unique experience in a unique region.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera. This is the last great wildlife challenge Bill has yet to conquer…Will he succeed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya and one of the most fascinating cities in Africa. On our visit we'll see the colonial architecture of a bygone era and the ultra-modern side of town as well. We'll learn the truth behind the "Out of Africa" story and our host gets eye-to-eye with some endangered giraffes.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Amboseli National Park has had several years of drought so we're anxious to see if the famous elephant herds are healthy. Journeys takes to the air and ground to get a count of these incredible animals. Along the way, we visit the local Masai to see how they're adjusting to encroaching civilization and we encounter buffalo, hippos and numerous bird species that make Amboseli so special.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A group of pro skiers travel a tough journey to South America in the hopes of experiencing the world-renown ski terrain Las Lenas, Argentina.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A world-class group of skiers explore epic backcountry terrain around Bralorne, B.C., areas accessible only by snowmobiles, with Canadian sled super-heroes as their guides.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Exoplanets, Thousands Of New Worlds
programme.desc: Are we alone in the universe? This question has been one of the greatest mysteries of all time. 20 years ago, individual scientists began to challenge traditional planetary science as they set off to seek, observe and reveal the existence of unknown worlds: EXOPLANETS. The film recounts the epic journey of these astrophysicists, who turned our knowledge of the universe upside down, in their quest for extraterrestrial life.

programme.title: Wax in the City
programme.desc: Africa is in fashion! Its flag? Wax print, which more and more Franco-African designers are choosing to incorporate into their creations. Flora Coquerel, a Franco-Beninese woman and the winner of MissFrance 2014, invites us to follow them in their intense and globalised life for a success story _ how the colours of a simple fabric have become the symbol of the cultural melting pot of an entire generation!

programme.title: Boteti: The Returning River
programme.desc: For 20 years the Boteti River in northern Botswana lay dry, leaving wildlife dependent on a handful of shrinking rain pools. Then, after decades of drought, heavy rains in the Angolan highlands send water flowing once more. Boteti _ The Returning River captures this dramatic rebirth, revealing how animals endured the harsh years and how the river's return transforms the landscape. Filmed over two years in stunning HD, the film documents rare behavior, explosive life, and the renewal of an entire ecosystem.

programme.title: The Ettore Majorana Mystery, An Absolute Physicist
programme.desc: The life and genius of Ettore Majorana, remains a source of fascination nearly 80 years after his mysterious disappearance in 1938. This Italian physicist pushed the boundaries of Quantum Physics and Cosmology and made a huge contribution to the understanding of the Nucleus, dark matter and its disappearance. As Science and History are intimately linked, could this be one of the reasons for Majorana's disappearance? An investigative novel and a scientific thriller in troubled decade of the 1930's in a world of the birth of the Atomic bomb.

programme.title: Carnival Of the Two Shores
programme.desc: Cuba and La Palma (Canary Islands), two islands joined together by the same ocean, celebrate their twinning with a unique festivity in which all participants dress in white and dust each other to the beats of sounds, guajiras and guarachas. It is "Los Indianos" Carnival, a wonderful experience with authentic Caribbean flavour.

programme.title: Carnival Of the Two Shores
programme.desc: Cuba and La Palma (Canary Islands), two islands joined together by the same ocean, celebrate their twinning with a unique festivity in which all participants dress in white and dust each other to the beats of sounds, guajiras and guarachas. It is "Los Indianos" Carnival, a wonderful experience with authentic Caribbean flavour.

programme.title: Last Call for Titan
programme.desc: Join this immersive journey to one of the last unchartered planet of our solar system, the sixth and largest moon of Saturn : TITAN. 12 years ago, after a 7-year-long interplanetary journey the Cassini-Huygens spacecraft marked history with the first landing ever accomplished in the outer Solar system, reaching Titan's surface. Based on the observations and data collected by the probe and the orbiter all through these years this film uses the latest light and sound simulation techniques to interpret visually for the first time the spectacle which has been hiding behind Saturn's dust cloud.

programme.title: Evita
programme.desc: She was considered the most powerful woman of her time. Together with Juan Domingo Perón she formed a legendary partnership that was a mixture of both fairy tale and of political struggle. The trajectory of a figure that inspired both unconditional love, and bitter hatred, and who, decades after her death, continues to influence Argentine politics.

programme.title: Yemen, Chaos in Silence
programme.desc: After three years of war, Yemen is facing its worst humanitarian crisis since the end of World War II. Yemen, "chaos in silence" is an unprecedented journey that tells the story of a conflict that is unfolding virtually without outside witnesses. From Aden in the south to Sanaa in the north, via Taez, the front line, this film explores a devastated country, eroded by political and religious divisions and ravaged by cholera.

programme.title: Life Is One
programme.desc: The return to life in the wild for 3 captive sun bears.

programme.title: Legendary Bandits of Mexico
programme.desc: Bandidos Legendarios is a documentary based in four mythical Mexican bandits, trying to find out why they became legendary. They are Joaquin Murrieta, Chucho el Roto, Los Plateados y Heraclio Bernal. Going through the key places where historical facts happened along with historians and specialists, each episode narrates the life of these bandits, trying to find the answers to the great questions that build the myth.

programme.title: Aramburus Assassination
programme.desc: July, 1st 1970, though Pindapoy operation, Montoneros guerrilla group assassinated Lieutenant General Pedro Aramburu, who in 1955 lead the power grab against General Perón. Constructed as a police drama, Aramburu's Assassination recreates previous scenes to the execution and studies Argentinean left wing guerillas 40 years after their appearance.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Westward ho! We settle in Salt Lake City, where we learn about Bringham Young's settlement of the Utah territory and his monument at This is the Place Park. Then we dig in the dirt to find hundreds of perfectly preserved dinosaurs at the Utah Natural History museum. We'll take a look at some US aviation history at the Hill Air force Base museum, and see how life was like for the Utah pioneers at Frontier Homestead State Park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: TTH heads to the great white North…kind of. We visit the world class city of Toronto. There we'll head straight up the Western Hemisphere's tallest structure, the CN Tower. Next we score a look at the Hockey Hall of Fame and see a North American castle at Casa Loma. Finally we see how the British defended their city against the newly formed United States at Fort York.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: China Uncovered
programme.desc: Despite the constant looming threat of globalization, some beloved old traditions, like the Szechuan chili and hotpots are still mainstays in Chinese culture. But while some traditions thrive, some face big challenges. A rare look at the enigma of Tibet shows a culture approaching a crossroads. Even the iconic pandas are dwindling if not for the aggressive breeding programs. Will old traditions stand a chance against the steam-rolling speeds and force of the new world?

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: Forty years after the end of the conflict, unexploded bombs, secret tunnels and other vestiges of the long combat still exist in Vietnam.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.desc: Paris and Berlin have developed and grown facing each other over four centuries of tumultuous historical relationships and mutual admiration. The architecture and urbanism bear witness of this complex and rich confrontation.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: "D-DAY" _ June 6th 1944: Normandy landings Personal and daily items such as helmets, badges, bullets, weapons, cans have been uncovered by recent archeological digs. These traces left behind by soldiers and civilians on the battle ground and findings of underground passages and blockhouses kept secret provide new insights into 2WW History.

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: Hitler's downfall began before the official end of the war in 1945. Specifically, on June 22, 1941. Hitler launched the largest military offensive in history _ against the USSR in Operation Barbarossa.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Go for launch! We visit Space Shuttle Endeavor at the California Science Center. Then, we check out the glitch and glamour at the Hollywood Museum. We'll learn about the Holocaust at the Holocaust Museum and Japanese Internment during WWII at the Japanese/American National Museum. After that, we dig for bones at the famous La Brea Tar Pits.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Up, up and away! We discover St. Petersburg Florida's aviation roots at the St.Pete History Museum. Then, comb your mustache, we visit the Dali Museum to look at Salvador Dali's amazing masterworks. We'll dredge the deep looking for sponges, and defend the bay at Fort Desoto.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.desc: Running Southbound outside on Central Coast with a big Tyee Chinook Release finish North of Milbanke Sound!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Chennai, formerly known as Madras, can trace its roots back to a tiny fishing village. Bill explores the city's growth under the British East India Company, with visits to Fort St. George and the Fort Museum. We then travel to the nearby Sao Tome Basilica, the church and burial site of St. Thomas the Apostle. In Pondicherry, French influences can still be felt in the tree-lined streets, colonial mansions and cafés. Its beautiful setting on the Bay of Bengal makes Pondicherry a delightful place to spend the day. We also visit the ancient port city of Mahabalipuram, where the landscape is dominated by carved-stone architecture. The final highlight of our tour is the Descent of Ganga, which is the world's largest bas-relief carving.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This ancient ruined city, lost to history, was one of the most powerful in the world during its prime. The architectural sophistication and sheer size will amaze. Then Journeys heads out to the deep ocean for some big game fishing. Will we land the big one or return empty handed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: This episode will follow "Team Cannondale" riders as they explore the European Alps, and all it has to offer for the mountain bike culture.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Kitesurfing is a sport that could not be better suited to an island location like Tahiti. With the sun, sand and an ocean breeze it is an ideal spot to spread your kite and surf.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing. But there's still one place in the world where sharks thrive _ the Bahamas. Sharks not only prosper there, they are highly protected. It's illegal to kill them. Stuart Cove's passion is sharks. Travelling In his private plane, he spreads the gospel of shark advocacy across the Bahamian island chain. And shark tourism is his livelihood. A successful entrepreneur, his main business revolves around scuba diving with sharks. Cove also works with Bahamian and international researchers in their studies of dangerous species such as tiger, hammerhead and bull sharks.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing all the fish, the sharks are protecting many of them! Then, Jonathan visits the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how college students conduct fieldwork in their pursuit of degrees in Marine Studies. He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA's Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon _ Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie _ Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia's skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle _ Australia's largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican _ Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds _ Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl _ Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture _ Africa's plains are scanned by vultures, nature's cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel _ Australia's smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The colossal elephant. The lush tropical forests of Asia hold within them some of nature's mightiest creatures.Each of these silent footsteps carries with it the immense weight of the world's largest land mammal. The intimidating birds with soaring grace and aerial prowess, birds dominate our skies. To remain the undisputed pioneers of the air most bird species are feather light and relatively small. The barrel-like Hippo Lumbering across land, the enormity of the barrel like hippo is without question. Other grass eaters are frail by comparison. The towering giraffe standing taller than any other living animal in their towering majesty is the proud and elegant giraffe. The gigantic whale the Mighty whale graces our oceans with a size and strength unrivalled on land. Three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighing more than a dozen hippos' the beautiful humpback whale is most famed for its mystical and haunting song. Which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Činjenica je da Bugari vole svinjetinu, ali Lora i Stojan je prosto obožavaju. Zato će podeliti recept za svinjetinu sa mirisnom korom i prilogom. Spremiće i neverovatnu kupus-salatu i za kraj, dezert koji se zove "Dunavski talasi".

programme.title: Dejvid Roko: Domaći slatkiši
programme.desc: Poslednjih godina, mnogi su prestali da putuju, pa i Dejvid Roko. Njega i porodicu su hrana i kuvanje zbližili. Dejvid sada otvara svoj dom i poziva porodicu i prijatelje da podele svoju priču o tome šta hrana znači za njih.

programme.title: Indija: Rik Stajn
programme.desc: Rik Stajn stiže u kulturni centar Laknau, koji važi za indijski, a možda i svetski, centar karija. Rik istražuje ovo nekadašnje utvrđenje Mogulskog carstva u potrazi za savršenom pilećom kormom i uči kako se pravi pilav.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Baš kao i rasprava oko toga da li je crvena ili zelena salsa bolja, tako je i država Novi Leon podeljena na ljubitelje fudbalskih klubova "Los Tigres" i "Los Rajados". Pati proba hranu na oba stadiona, a zvezde ekipa će proglasiti pobedničko jelo.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Ikona pekarskog zanata Meksika, Irving Kiroz vodi Pati u svoju radionicu u Montereju, i uči je da pripremi tradicionalni kampečanas i kornete od krema. Zatim upoznajemo Irvingovog učenika, Čuja Elizondoa koji želi da se proslavi svojim hlebom.

programme.title: Gurman za svaki dan: Slatkiši
programme.desc: Džastin Skofild se vraća sa drugom sezonom serije "Gurman za svaki dan: Slatkiši", okupljajući australijske poslastičare da podele ukusne, ali ostvarive deserte. Sezona je prepuna pametnih saveta, prelepih peciva i slatke inspiracije za svakoga.

programme.title: Gurman za svaki dan: Slatkiši

programme.title: Ejnslijevi praznični ukusi
programme.desc: Najveseliji britanski kuvar se vraća u serijalu "Ejnslijevi praznični ukusi", sa novim menijem, mnogo zabave i dobrih saveta. Ejnsli Harijot otvara vrata svoje kuhinje i gledaoci i gosti imaju odličan pogled na sve što se priprema.

programme.title: Kraljica čokolade: Veoma čokoladni Božić
programme.desc: Stižu svečane poslastice! Kraljica čokolade Kirsten Tibals vraća se sa božićnom emisijom. Uz pomoć specijalnih gostiju, stvoriće kreacije savršene za praznične proslave. Gledajte magičnu mešavinu omiljenih slatkiša za slavlja i slatkih iznenađenja!

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: Da bi se pravilno upoznala neka kultura, potrebno je upoznati njenu hranu. Hrana neke države otkriva detalje o klimi, kreativnosti i duši. Ova kulinarska avantura počinje na vrhu jedne od najzanimljivijih država na svetu.

programme.title: Kuvar van dužnosti

programme.title: Kuvar van dužnosti
programme.desc: Branč je savršen način za početak vikenda, i ove nedelje Mark će podeliti recepte za svoja omiljena jela. Prvo na redu biće šakšuka s korizom. Iznenadićete se koliko se dobro ovo jelo od pečenih jaja uklapa u kasni doručak, ali i večeru.

programme.title: Ejnslijevi praznični ukusi

programme.desc: Rik Stajn putuje u zemlju kraljeva Radžastan. Većina stanovnika Radžastana su ozbiljni ljubitelji mesa. Omiljeno jelo je džungel mas, koje je savršena mešavina mesa, čili papričica i začina. Većina države je prekrivena pustinjom.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Porodica Garza poziva Pati na tradicionalnu proslavu vinarije, kada otvaraju vrata za celu zajednicu da pomognu u pripremi šećera piloncilo na tradicionalni način. Svi priskaču u pomoć u mešanju, jer mešanje ne sme da stane, a to nije lak posao.

programme.desc: "Huerto Urbane" ili urbane farme pomažu u rešavanju problema proizvodnje hrane u neadekvatnim uslovima, koja se potom daje restoranima i porodicama koje žele zdravu hranu. Suprug vlasnice ovih farmi jedan je od pionira kulinarske inovacije Montereja.

programme.title: Ejnslijevi fantastični ukusi
programme.desc: U prvoj epizodi serijala, Ejnsli istražuje kako začini poboljšavaju jela kao što su šakšuka sa ras el hanout i ljutkastu, meksičku verziju, jednog klasičnog britanskog jela.

programme.title: Vrhunski Božić Meri Beri
programme.desc: Veoma voljenoj kuvarici, dami Meri Beri, pridružuju se poznati prijatelji za njenu vrhunsku božićnu gozbu. Planiranje je Merin najbolji savet za uspešan i prijatan dan, a ovde ona deli svoje definitivne recepte usavršavane tokom 50 godina.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: Adam i Po odlaze u regiju Gipsland u Australiji, da bi otkrili ljubav prema jednostavnoj domaćoj hrani i pokušali da pripreme najbolji australijski porodični obrok.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: U svakom regionalnom gradiću u Australiji, moguće je naći tri ključna dela australijske kulture i kuhinje, a to su: bar, pekara i restoran kineske hrane.

programme.title: Džejmijev božićni kuvar
programme.desc: Džejmi Oliver sprema božićne obroke skoro dve decenije. Usput je isprobao raznolike vrste klasičnih jela. Ove godine, Džejmi želi da nam pokaže svoje najbolje recepte. Recepte, za koje je siguran da su savršeni za božićni obrok.

programme.title: Kuvar van dužnosti
programme.desc: Ove nedelje Mark priprema brza i ukusna jela, čiji je glavni sastojak testenina, koju uvek imamo u špajzu. Mark pravi svoju verziju klasičnog italijanskog jela, lazanje od piletine i gljiva. Zatim slede špagete sa školjkama, belim lukom i čilijem.

programme.title: Kuvar van dužnosti
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi povrće je zvezda, i Mark će pokazati kako ga pripremiti s ljubavlju i pažnjom, da bi njegova neverovatna aroma došla do izražaja. Prvi na redu je pečeni karfiol iz šerpe, koji će sigurno zadiviti. Zatim, Mark priprema povrtni "dahl".

programme.title: Ejnslijevi fantastični ukusi
programme.desc: U prvoj epizodi serijala, Ejnsli istražuje kako začini poboljšavaju jela kao što su šakšuka sa ras el hanout i ljutkastu, meksičku verziju, jednog klasičnog britanskog jela.

programme.title: Indija: Rik Stajn
programme.desc: Rik Stajn odlazi u hotel sa pet zvezdica u Maduraju u državi Tamil Nadu. U hotelu rade prave domaćice kako bi se gosti osećali kao kod kuće. Rik isprobava piletinu četinad, jelo koje su trgovci doneli sa istoka i zapada.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Kantine su tradicionalno bili barovi gde muškarci dolaze da piju, jedu i vesele se ili da razgovaraju o svojim slomljenim srcima. Pati upoznaje autora i istoričara kantina Dejvida Kanalesa koji vodi Pati u dve različite kantine u Montereju.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Prvi put na prestižnom takmičenju u pripremi roštilja u Hjustonu Meksikanac iz Linaresa osvojio je treće mesto. Luis Rivas sve te arome prenosi u svoj restoran "Riv's". Pati ide u restoran da vidi razliku između asade s mesom i teksaškog roštilja.

programme.title: Adam i Po: Malezija u Australiji - Ukusni australijski obroci
programme.desc: U svakom regionalnom gradiću u Australiji, moguće je naći tri ključna dela australijske kulture i kuhinje, a to su: bar, pekara i restoran kineske hrane.

programme.title: Vrhunski Božić Meri Beri
programme.desc: Veoma voljenoj kuvarici, dami Meri Beri, pridružuju se poznati prijatelji za njenu vrhunsku božićnu gozbu. Planiranje je Merin najbolji savet za uspešan i prijatan dan, a ovde ona deli svoje definitivne recepte usavršavane tokom 50 godina.

programme.title: Vrhunski Božić Meri Beri
programme.desc: Veoma voljenoj kuvarici, dami Meri Beri, pridružuju se poznati prijatelji za njenu vrhunsku božićnu gozbu. Planiranje je Merin najbolji savet za uspešan i prijatan dan, a ovde ona deli svoje definitivne recepte usavršavane tokom 50 godina.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: Recepti za čorbe od pasulja uvek su dobrodošle. Stojan i Lora su odlučili da podele tradicionalan recept Stojanove porodice, sa carskim mesom, mnogo povrća i mirisnim divljim kimom. Sve će biti propraćeno ukusnim hlebom sa susamom.

programme.title: Dejvid Roko: Domaći slatkiši
programme.desc: Poslednjih godina, mnogi su prestali da putuju, pa i Dejvid Roko. Njega i porodicu su hrana i kuvanje zbližili. Dejvid sada otvara svoj dom i poziva porodicu i prijatelje da podele svoju priču o tome šta hrana znači za njih.

programme.title: Indija: Rik Stajn
programme.desc: Rik Stajn odlazi u hotel sa pet zvezdica u Maduraju u državi Tamil Nadu. U hotelu rade prave domaćice kako bi se gosti osećali kao kod kuće. Rik isprobava piletinu četinad, jelo koje su trgovci doneli sa istoka i zapada.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Kantine su tradicionalno bili barovi gde muškarci dolaze da piju, jedu i vesele se ili da razgovaraju o svojim slomljenim srcima. Pati upoznaje autora i istoričara kantina Dejvida Kanalesa koji vodi Pati u dve različite kantine u Montereju.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Prvi put na prestižnom takmičenju u pripremi roštilja u Hjustonu Meksikanac iz Linaresa osvojio je treće mesto. Luis Rivas sve te arome prenosi u svoj restoran "Riv's". Pati ide u restoran da vidi razliku između asade s mesom i teksaškog roštilja.

programme.title: Gurman za svaki dan: Slatkiši
programme.desc: Džastin Skofild se vraća sa drugom sezonom serije "Gurman za svaki dan: Slatkiši", okupljajući australijske poslastičare da podele ukusne, ali ostvarive deserte. Sezona je prepuna pametnih saveta, prelepih peciva i slatke inspiracije za svakoga.

programme.title: Prijatno
programme.desc: U ovoj epizodi, Lora i Stojan će podeliti dva recepta za punjene sarmice, jedne sa listom kupusa a druge sa listovima vinove loze. U jelima neće biti mesa, ali neće biti ništa lošija zbog toga. Za kraj spremaju baklavu kakvu pravi Stojanova majka.

programme.desc: Bivši svetski mladi kuvar godine slavi irske korene svojih voljenih recepata. Kuvar van dužnosti odlazi do kuće svojih roditelja u Vest Keriju, gde istražuje priobalno i seosko okruženje koje je inspirisalo neka od njegovih omiljenih jela.

programme.title: Kuvar van dužnosti
programme.desc: Mark obožava da organizuje večernje proslave za porodicu i prijatelje, i iako je zaposlen u restoranu nagrađenom Mišelinovom zvezdom, kada ne radi, Mark obožava da priprema prava, domaća jela. Za početak, oživeće klasik, u obliku koktela od škampa.

programme.desc: Rik Stajn kreće na novu gastronomsku avanturu od Venecije do Istanbula kroz zemlje bivše Vizantije, u kojoj su se susretali Istok i Zapad. Njegovo putovanje počinje u Veneciji i na idiličnom grčkom ostrvu Simi, gde sprema svoja omiljena venecijanska jela.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Kuvar Hugo Gvajardo pomera granice lokalne kuhinje u svom restoranu "El Jonuco", koristeći najbolje lokalne sastojke. Prvo odlazi u restoran "El Caminante" gde nabavlja sušeno meso. Pati ruča u Hugovom restoranu i jede njegove verzije poznatih jela.

programme.title: Patina meksička jela
programme.desc: Patini novi prijatelji planinari vode je na avanturu da bi izbliza videla planine. Zatim jedu elote, grilovani meksički kukuruz preliven prelivom nortenja. Kasnije Pati poziva četiri vrhunska kuvara i pravi im karne asadu.

programme.title: Mark Morijarti: Kuvar van dužnosti vraća se kući
