programme.title: Umjetnik, film
programme.desc: Film koji bez riječi, vrhunskom estetikom, duhovitošću i snažnim scenama utjelovljuje neka prošla vremena, iskrene osjećaje i životne vrijednosti, nikako nemojte propustiti. Priča je to o Georgeu Valentinu (Jean Dujardin) zvijezdi nijemog filma koja ne pronalazi svoje mjesto u eri zvučnog filma i teško se s time nosi. Neuspjehe u karijeri zasjenila je ljubav prema Peppy Miller (Bérénice Bejo), mladoj glumici na vrhuncu karijere. Michel Hazanavicius predstavlja toplu i zabavnu priču o klasičnom američkom filmu. Mješavinom komedije, romanse i melodrame primjer je forme koju slavi: jedinstveni čar crno-bijelog nijemog filma koji se temelji na slikama, glumcima i glazbi. Svečanost 84. dodjele nagrade Oscar održana je jučer, 26. veljače u Los Angelesu. Zasigurno će u dobrom sjećanju ostati ekipi filma Umjetnik. "Umjetnik" oda je starom Hollywoodu, crno-bijeli, nijemi film, oduševio je i publiku i kritiku. Osvojio je tri Zlatna globusa, sedam nagrada BAFTA te deset nominacija s kojima je ušao u finalnu večer dodjele nagrade Oscar. Film Umjetnik (The Artist) na ovogodišnjoj dodijeli osvojio je pet Oscara i to u najvažnijim kategorijama: Najbolji film Najbolji glavni glumac - Jean Dujardin Najbolja režija - Michel Haznavicius Najbolja glazba skladana za film Najbolja kostimografija

programme.title: Divlja Ruža, film
programme.desc: 22-g. Rose-Lynn izlazi iz zatvora nakon godinu dana zbog manjeg kaznenog djela, no nije puno toga naučila i željna je nastaviti točno gdje je stala - želi postati country pjevačica. Činjenicu da ima dvoje djece mlađe od 10 g. i za koju se već godini dana brine njezina majka nekako je zaboravila, ili je pogurana u dio mozga u kojemu je spremljeno 'ono za kasnije'. Prvo se želi naći s Elliotom, no shvati da jednostavno odgađa neizbježno i da se mora suočiti sa svojom majkom Marion. Kad napokon dođe k majci, postane jasno, njihov odnos je leden, najblaže rečeno. Rose-Lynn se osjeti kao da je iz jednoga zatvora otišla u drugi. Majka joj govori da se zaposli kao čistačica, no ona samo želi pjevati. Hoće li uspjeti?

programme.title: Replicant, film
programme.desc: Policija uzaludno pokušava uhvatiti serijskog ubojicu Edwarda Garrottea zvanog Baklja (J.-C. Van Damme) koji svoje žrtve, sve redom majke s djecom, spaljuje nakon što ih mučki ubije. Nakon posljednjeg, jedanaestog ubojstva tim istražitelja na čelu s Jakeom Rileyjem (M. Rooker) i njegovom kolegicom Angie (C. Dent) nađe se u gotovo bezizglednoj situaciji. No, na mjestu zločina pronađen je ubojičin DNK, što je ekipu znanstvenika predvođenu Stanom Reismanom (I. Robinson) navelo na nesvakidašnju odluku. Pomoću ubojičina genetskog materijala načinili su njegovog klona s kojim će mu pokušati ući u trag. No, Garrotteova slika i prilika zbunjeni je pojedinac koji se počne prisjećati počinjenih nedjela svog originala. Usto, replikant će se sjetiti i strašne traume iz djetinjstva za koje je odgovorna njegova majka (M. Ryan)... Iako je zenit karijere belgijske glumačke zvijezde međunarodnog sjaja Jean-Claudea Van Dammea bio početak 1990-ih (Double Impact, Hard Target), ni desetljeće kasnije ovaj majstor borilačkih vještina nije prestao zanimati hollywoodske producente. Tako je 2001. snimljen ambiciozno zamišljeni znanstveno-fantastični akcijski triler Replikant s Van Dammeom u glavnoj ulozi. Za redatelja je izabran cijenjeni hongkonški filmaš Ringo Lam (Full Alert, The Victim) čiji je film City on Fire svojedobno nadahnuo Quentina Tarantina na njegov hit Reservoir Dogs. Uz proračun od 17 milijuna dolara film je snimljen na lokacijama u Vancouveru, a priča prati nastojanja policijskih snaga predvođenih detektivom Rileyjem da uhvate suludog serijskog ubojicu zvanog Baklja koji svoje žrtve nakon ubojstva spaljuje. Van Dammeu je pripala dvostruka uloga središnjeg zlikovca i njegovog klona kojeg policija načini od ubojičinog DNK ne bi li mu upravo na ovakav način ušla u trag. Spoj uvijek popularnih zapleta o serijskim ubojicama, frenetične akcije garnirane Van Dammeovom okretnošću, elemenata buddy-buddy filmova i sve intrigantijih dvojbi o dometima suvremene genetike, Lamov je film dobio solidne ocjene. Iako u SAD-u nije stigao u kinodvorane, već je izravno plasiran na videotržište, kinopublika u ostalim zemljama imala se prigodu uvjeriti da je glavni glumac i dalje uzor svojim mlađim kolegama kada je riječ o borilačkim prizorima. Partner mu je vrlo dobri Michael Rooker (JFK, Cliffhanger), dok je vodeća ženska uloga pripala Catherine Dent (Nobody's Fool, serija The Shield).

programme.title: Galveston, film
programme.desc: Roy je zločinac koji pije, te je i mafijaš ubojica kojemu šef, Stan, mafijaš iz New Orleansa, smjesti da pogine na dan kad je Roy primio vijesti da ima rak pluća. Roy predvidi Stanov plan, no ubiju ubojice prije negoli obave svoj posao. Roy upozna Rocky, tinejdžersku prostitutku, koju povede sa sobom, i tako je spasi od opasnosti od Stana i njegovih momaka. Roy i Rocky žele pobjeći u Galveston, u Teksasu, mjesto koje Roy zna iz svoje tajanstvene prošlosti. Rocky uvjeri Roya da po putu stanu, i završe s Rockynom trogodišnjom sestrom Tiffany koju spasi od poočima… Žive po motelima u kojima obitavaju gosti upitnoga morala, ovaj trojac se poveže kako se još Roy i Rocky nisu povezali ni sa kim. No opasnosti iz Royeve i Rockyne prošlosti bliže su negoli Roy to zna…

programme.title: Daleki rođaci: Francuska revolucija, film
programme.desc: Godefroy de Montmirail i njegov vjerni sluga Jacquouille iznenada se zateknu u razdoblju velikih političkih i društvenih previranja u vrijeme Francuske revolucije, točnije jakobinske diktature. Otkrivaju da su njihovi potomci ostali bez dvorca i sve imovine koju su im oteli bahati aristokrati. Daju se u bijeg kako bi izvukli živu glavu... Ovo je treći film u trilogiji "Daleki rođaci", nastavak filma "Daleki rođaci 2" snimljenog osamnaest godina ranije, 1998. i prvog filma u serijalu snimljenog dvadeset i tri godine ranije, 1993. U trećem se nastavku pojavljuju samo tri glumca iz prethodna dva filma: Christian Clavier, Jean Reno i Marie-Anne Chazel. Od njih troje, samo Reno i Clavier igraju iste likove koje su igrali u prethodnim nastavcima: srednjovjekovnog viteza Godefroyja de Montmiraila i njegova štitonoše Jacquouillea la Fripouillea.

programme.desc: Snimljen prema istoimenom bestselleru, filmsku senzaciju Igre gladi nazivaju novim Sumrakom! programme.desc: Kad Will (Bang) otkrije da su mu supruga Rosalind (Kurylenko) i njihovo troje djece iznenada su nestali, kreće u mahnitu potragu po Europi. Napokon ih pronalazi u zabačenom selu na sjeveru Francuske, ali olakšanje se pretvara u užas kad Will otkrije da mu je sin misteriozno preminuo. programme.desc: Wila zatoče, pa Eretria i Mareth moraju surađivati ne bi li ga oslobodile prije nego što vrijeme istekne.

programme.title: Igre gladi: Plamen, film
programme.desc: Nakon pobjede u Igrama gladi, Katniss Evedeen (Jennifer Lawrence) i Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) vraćaju se u svoj dom, Okrug 12, u kojem predsjednik Snow (Donald Sutherland), koji je namjestio završetak posljednjih igara, posjećuju Katniss u njezinoj kući te joj govori kako je njezina pobjeda potaknula pobune po okruzima te joj zapovjedi da „Pobjedičku turneju, na koju uskoro kreće, iskoristi da bi pobunjenike uvjerila da su njezini potezi bili iskreni, iz ljubavi prema Peeti, a ne kao čin pobune prema Capitolu. U protivnom, ako ona to ne učini, svi koje voli, kao i čitav okrug, bit će uništeni, baš poput Okruga 13.

programme.title: Dar, film
programme.desc: Annie (Cate Blanchett) je udovica i majka tri sina koja posjeduje posebni dar; vidovnjaštvo, te obitelj uzdržava tarotom. Nedugo nakon što joj je prijetio Donnie Barksdale (Keanu Reeves), suprug i zlostavljač njezine klijentice, nestane kći ( Katie Holmes) istaknutog građanina i ujedno zaručnica školskog ravnatelja. Annie odvodi policiju do trupla u Donnijevu ribnjaku. Na suđenju i poslije suđenja, ova vidovnjakinja mora se suočiti s napadima na vjerodostojnost njezinih vizija, saznanjima o ljubavnicima ubijene, vlastitom privlačnosti prema ravnatelju,14 te krizom koju je uzrokovala mentalna bolest njezinog susjeda. No muče je i vizije: što ako je Donnie nevin?

programme.title: Dar, film
programme.desc: Annie (Cate Blanchett) je udovica i majka tri sina koja posjeduje posebni dar; vidovnjaštvo, te obitelj uzdržava tarotom. Nedugo nakon što joj je prijetio Donnie Barksdale (Keanu Reeves), suprug i zlostavljač njezine klijentice, nestane kći ( Katie Holmes) istaknutog građanina i ujedno zaručnica školskog ravnatelja. programme.title: Rainin strah, film
programme.desc: 17-g. Rain Burroughs je tipična tinejdžerica… s netipičnom bolesti: rana pojava shizofrenije. Nakon što se Rain vrati kući iz bolnice, upozna neobično lijepoga i mučno čudnoga Caleba. Čini se predobar da bi bio istinit - a itekako bi mogao biti. Dok se bori s mladom ljubavlju, mora potisnuti autodestruktivne i manipulativne sile koje joj proždiru um. No onaj, koji je puno strašniji od čovjeka koji opsjeda njezine snove, stvarni je susjed koji je, u što je Rain uvjerena, oteo djevojčicu i drži je zatočenu na njihovom tavanu. Hoće li Rain uspjeti razdvojiti zamršenu mrežu činjenica i fikcije?

programme.title: Obitelji poput naše, mini-serija
programme.desc: Sve je mračno. Uniformirani ljudi pretukli su Eliasa skoro do smrti i ostavili na poljskoj plaži. Laura, uzalud čekajući Eliasa, ulazi u zadnji vlak za Bukurešt. Ponovno se susreće sa svojom iznenađenom majkom. Na trenutak se osjećaju kao najsretnije na svijetu. Jacob i Amalie putuju na jug Francuske posljednjim novčićem, nadajući se pomoći upravitelja hotela kojega je Amalie posjećivala kao mala.

programme.title: Opsesija, film
programme.desc: Hunter (Haley Bennett) je tek zatrudnjela no njezin život krene u drukčijem smjeru kad razvije opsesiju gutanja opasnih predmeta. Njezin suprug (Austin Stowell) i njegova obitelj preuzmu nadzor nad njezinim životom, pa se ona mora suočiti s mračnom tajnom koja stoji iza opsesije koju ne može kontrolirati. Ovo je priča koja nalikuje na deformiranu bajku koja potiče provokativna pitanja o očekivanjima nametnutima ženama, ženinoj kontroli nad svojim tijelom, i psihološkim škodljivim učincima patrijarhata. Bennett je sjajno odigrala ulogu u ovom smjelom filmu koji je redateljski prvijenac Carla Mirabella-Davisa.

programme.title: Plava iguana, film
programme.desc: Ovaj triler predstavlja ludu akciju, komediju i pravu ljubav. Eddie, Paul i Katherine su kul, bezbrižni likovi u svijetu apsolutnih sloboda: sloboda da kradu, pucaju iz pištolja, ubijaju, i zaljubljuju se. I sloboda gdje vas ne mogu ozlijediti - bar ne ozbiljno. Samo negativci umiru. Sam Rockwell i Ben Schwartz tumače dva londonska kompića čije nevjerojatne budalaštine nikad nemaju ozbiljne posljedice. Uvijek se izvuku, uz duhovite primjedbe, oružje i osmijeh. Eddie i Paul dva su nevinašca, iako oni uopće nisu tako nevini. Pametnjakovići koji nikad nisu shvaćali ozbiljnost neke situacije. Tu je i Katherine, engleska odvjetnica, koja im ponudi nešto što ne mogu odbiti, koja je uvijek korak ispred svih - no je li se ona spremna zaljubiti?

programme.title: Polarna avantura, film
programme.desc: Arktička lisica Swifty radi u poštanskoj službi, ali sanja o tome da jednog dana postane Top Dog - arktički haski kurir. Da bi dokazao da je vrijedan uloge, tajno zapovijeda isporuku paketa na tajanstvenu lokaciju. Na putu prema tamo naleti na nepoznatu tvrđavu u kojoj se suočava sa zlobnim genijem Ottom Von Walrus, koji ima mehaničke noge i zapovijeda lojalnoj vojsci neobično uljudnih sljedbenika. Swifty uskoro otkriva da Von Walrusov planira otopiti polarne ledene kape i poplaviti svijet kako bi njime zavladao. Swifty se pretvara u pravoj junaka te će uz pomoć svojih prijatelja spasiti svijet od Walrusa.

programme.title: Igre gladi: Plamen, film
programme.desc: Nakon pobjede u Igrama gladi, Katniss Evedeen (Jennifer Lawrence) i Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) vraćaju se u svoj dom, Okrug 12, u kojem predsjednik Snow (Donald Sutherland), koji je namjestio završetak posljednjih igara, posjećuju Katniss u njezinoj kući te joj govori kako je njezina pobjeda potaknula pobune po okruzima te joj zapovjedi da „Pobjedičku turneju, na koju uskoro kreće, iskoristi da bi pobunjenike uvjerila da su njezini potezi bili iskreni, iz ljubavi prema Peeti, a ne kao čin pobune prema Capitolu. U protivnom, ako ona to ne učini, svi koje voli, kao i čitav okrug, bit će uništeni, baš poput Okruga 13.

programme.title: Igre gladi: Šojka rugalica 1. dio, film
programme.desc: Nakon što su spašeni iz razrušene arene, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence), Beetee (Jeffrey Wright) i Finnick Odair (Sam Claflin) odvedeni su u Okrug 13, koji se odvojio od Panema i koji predvodi pobunu. Tamo je Katniss ponovno ujedinjena s majkom i sestrom Prim (Willow Shields). I dok se odmara i prikuplja snagu, u posjet joj stiže predsjednica Alma Coin (Julianne Moore), koja vodi pobunu. Otkriva joj da su se, nakon što je njezina strijela probila zaštitno polje, digle pobune u više od pola okruga Panema te su se svi pridružili Okrugu 13. Nakon rascjepa, kao čin odmazde, Snow (Donald Sutherland) je bombardirao Okrug 12. Coin zatraži Katniss da postane Šojka rugalica, simbol pobune, što ona odbije, no kada vidi kako s Peetom (Josh Hutcherson) manipuliraju na državnoj televiziji, ona pristane pod uvjetom da se njega spasi iz ruku diktatorskog Kapitola.

programme.title: Bravar, film
programme.desc: Miller je vrsni bravar, tek izašao iz zatvora nakon što je pljačka pošla po zlu. Kod kuće se pokušava pomiriti sa svojom kćeri i bivšom djevojkom, Beth, koja je napredovala u policijskim redovima dok je Miller bio u zatvoru. Unatoč obećanju da će početi iznova, Miller je prisiljen uporabiti svoje bravarske vještine kako bi pomogao prijatelju u nevolji. Kad plan ne ide kako je isplaniran, mora ugroziti svoj život kako bi spasio svoju obitelj.

programme.title: Kuća tame, film
programme.desc: Film KUĆA TAME prati muškarca koji, nakon što su se sreli na piću u mjesnom baru, vozi ženu kući. No, kada ga pozove u svoj dom na piće, večer ne slijedi poznati put prema zavođenju. Vrata škripe i svjetla trepere i gase se dok muškarac nastavlja zavoditi, čak i kada neočekivani događaji ponište njegove pokušaje romantične veze s tim tajanstvenim objektom njegove želje.

programme.title: Obitelji poput naše, mini-serija
programme.desc: Život nekako ide dalje. Laura konobari u restoranu, na pauzi sanja o Eliasu no boji se da je mrtav. Nedostaju joj najmiliji. Na Badnjak je sama, i samo razgovara s Jacobom. Tješi je; tuga je cijena koju plaćamo za ljubav. Na poslu u novogodišnjoj noći, Laura se napije i završi s neznancem. Sutradan, Elias se iznenada vraća. Živ je, ali sjena onoga što je bio prije. Planira k majci u Finsku.

programme.title: Dok spavaš, film
programme.desc: Svi poznajemo svoje prijatelje, ali što je s poznanicima? Ljudi koji u našim životima imaju male uloge,kojliko ih dobro poznajemo? I koliko ih mi dobro poznajemo? Netko vas promatra. Cesar radi kao vratar stambene zgrade u Barceloni. Sreća mu konstantno izmiče pa ima potrebu potvrditi razloge za svakodnevni život. Na poslu je gotovo nezamijećen, ali zato vrlo dobro poznaje stanare zgrade u kojoj radi. Zna sve njihove intimne detalje, posebice o Clari, mladoj djevojci pozitivnog pogleda na život. Njezina sreća čini Cesara vrlo nervoznim i on neće biti zadovoljan dok joj zauvijek ne izbriše taj osmjeh s lica, jer Cesar se hrani tuđom nesrećom. On uživa u boli i tjeskobi drugih ljudi, i ništa mu nije draže do gledanja ljudske patnje, pogotovo ako je on tome uzrok. U Clari je pronašao savršenu metu, i ide do krajnjih granica ne bi li joj zagorčao život. Međutim, on postaje i suviše odvažan, i njegovi pažljivo smišljeni planovi počinju se otkrivati. Ali srećom, ima još jednog asa u rukavu...

programme.title: Zamračenje, film
programme.desc: Od producenata filmova Paranormalno, Insidious i Zla kob dolazi Zamračenje - nadnaravni triler koji prati život mlade obitelji u predgrađu. Supružnici Daniel i Lacy Barrett postaju svjedoci eskalirajućem nizu uznemirujućih događaja u vlastitoj obitelji zbog čega se njihov siguran i miran dom ubrzo počinje raspadati. Nakon što postaje jasno da su Baretti na meti nevjerojatno zastrašujuće i smrtonosne sile, Daniel i Lacy preuzimaju stvar u svoje ruke kako bi zaštitili obitelj i riješili misteriju onoga što ih prati.

programme.title: Belle i Sebastian: Nova generacija, film
programme.desc: Desetogodišnji Sebastian nevoljko provodi odmor u planinama s bakom i rođakinjom. Treba im pomoć oko ovaca, što baš i nije tako uzbudljivo za gradskog dečka poput njega... On cijelo vrijeme naime razmišlja o Belle, neizmjerno snažnoj ženki pirinejskog planinskog psa koju maltretira njezin vlasnik. Spreman učiniti sve da zaštiti Belle i da se izbori protiv nepravde, Sebastian će provesti najluđe ljeto svog života.

programme.title: Volim, ne volim, film
programme.desc: Mlada Helen (G. Paltrow) atraktivna je Londončanka koja jednog dana, dobivši otkaz na poslu u agenciji za odnose s javnošću, na putu kući ljutita i depresivna u posljednjem trenutku pokuša stići na podzemnu željeznicu. Dok ona uskače u vlak, ili joj se barem tako čini, njezin se život počinje odvijati u dva smjera. U jednom ona uspijeva uloviti podzemnu u kojoj upozna markantnog Jamesa (J. Hannah) te, neplanirano ranije stigne kući i svog dečka Gerryja (J. Lynch) zatekne u krevetu s njegovom bivšom djevojkom Lydijom (J. Tripplehorn). U paralelnom životu Helen zakasni u podzemnu te čekajući taksi doživi napad uličnog pljačkaša, zbog čega kasnije stigne u stan što Gerryju dade dovoljno vremena da prikrije preljub. U tom životu Helen ne zna za Gerryjevu nevjeru, pa u želji da mu udovolji pristaje i na ponižavajući posao konobarice. Istodobno i Lydia postaje sve ljubomornija te Gerryju sve češće priređuje ljubomorne ispade. Istodobno, u prvoj priči Helen prekine s nevjernim Gerryjem, promijeni boju kose i uz pomoć susretljivog Jamesa odluči otvoriti vlastitu agenciju za odnose s javnošću...

programme.title: Volim, ne volim, film
programme.desc: Mlada Helen (G. Paltrow) atraktivna je Londončanka koja jednog dana, dobivši otkaz na poslu u agenciji za odnose s javnošću, na putu kući ljutita i depresivna u posljednjem trenutku pokuša stići na podzemnu željeznicu. Dok ona uskače u vlak, ili joj se barem tako čini, njezin se život počinje odvijati u dva smjera. U jednom ona uspijeva uloviti podzemnu u kojoj upozna markantnog Jamesa (J. Hannah) te, neplanirano ranije stigne kući i svog dečka Gerryja (J. Lynch) zatekne u krevetu s njegovom bivšom djevojkom Lydijom (J. Tripplehorn). U paralelnom životu Helen zakasni u podzemnu te čekajući taksi doživi napad uličnog pljačkaša, zbog čega kasnije stigne u stan što Gerryju dade dovoljno vremena da prikrije preljub. Istodobno, u prvoj priči Helen prekine s nevjernim Gerryjem, promijeni boju kose i uz pomoć susretljivog Jamesa odluči otvoriti vlastitu agenciju za odnose s javnošću...

programme.desc: Bandon i njegovi sljedbenici žure uskrsnuti Gospodara vještaca dok Mareth mora sve staviti na kocku prije negoli bude prekasno.

programme.title: Kronike Shannare, serija
programme.desc: Wil je primoran suočiti se sa svojom prošlošću. Veza između Allanona i Mareth sve je dublja.

programme.title: Igre gladi: Šojka rugalica 2. dio, film
programme.desc: Nakon što je postala vođom masovne pobune potlačenog naroda, u epskoj završnici jedne od najpopularnijih filmskih franšiza u povijesti, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) pokreće sveopću revoluciju protiv Capitola. U ulozi heroine, Katniss shvaća kako na kocki nije tek preživljavanje, već budućnost cijeloga naroda. U završnom obračunu, Katniss i njezini prijatelji sukobit će se s predsjednikom Snowom (Donald Sutherland) i pokušati ga uništiti prije nego što on ostvari svoj naum i ubije nju. Brojni neprijatelji, smrtonosne zamke i životna iskušenja pokazat će se puno većim zalogajem od bilo koje arene u kojoj se dosad borila tijekom održavanja Igara gladi!

programme.title: Grof Monte Cristo, film
programme.desc: Spektakularna visokobudžetna avantura nastala prema istoimenom klasiku Alexandrea Dumasa, jednog od filmskoj industriji najmilijih klasika. Meta mračnog plana, mladi Edmond Dantès uhićen je na dan svog vjenčanja zbog zločina koji nije počinio. Nakon četrnaest godina u otočnom zatvoru Château d’If, uspijeva izvesti smion bijeg. Sada bogat iznad svojih snova, preuzima identitet Grofa Monte Crista i osvećuje se trojici muškaraca koji su ga izdali.

programme.title: Grof Monte Cristo, film
programme.desc: Spektakularna visokobudžetna avantura nastala prema istoimenom klasiku Alexandrea Dumasa, jednog od filmskoj industriji najmilijih klasika. Meta mračnog plana, mladi Edmond Dantès uhićen je na dan svog vjenčanja zbog zločina koji nije počinio. Nakon četrnaest godina u otočnom zatvoru Château d’If, uspijeva izvesti smion bijeg. programme.title: Đavolji plijen, film
programme.desc: Katolička se crkva bori protiv globalnog porasta opsjednutosti demonima otvaranjem škole za obuku svećenika koji će provoditi obrede egzorcizma. Na ovom duhovnom bojnom polju pojavljuje se neobičan ratnik: mlada redovnica, sestra Ann. Iako je časnim sestrama zabranjeno izvoditi egzorcizme, profesor prepoznaje njezinu nadarenost i pristaje je trenirati. Uz podršku mentora, dopušteno joj je promatrati stvarne prakse. Kada se susretne s jednim od najtežih slučajeva, splasnut će njezina želja i volja za dokazivanjem. Tijekom tih mučnih susreta, sestra Ann suočava se licem u lice s demonskom silom koja napada ustanovu u kojoj radi i ima tajanstvene veze s njezinom prošlošću. Tada se moć zla i njezine vlastite zapanjujuće sposobnosti u potpunosti razotkrivaju.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Paul Novak
programme.desc: Naizgled heroj, bolničar Paul Novak nakon 11. rujna skrivao je tamnu stranu koja je kulminirala brutalnim ubojstvom njegove otuđene supruge Catherine u njihovoj kući u okrugu Sullivan.

programme.title: Suncem obasjana ubojstva
programme.desc: Dva se stranca susreću dok putuju s ruksakom kroz Tajland i frcaju iskre. Ali ova novopečena romansa u raju završava užasnom tragedijom.

programme.title: Ubojstvo u motelu, Ludo ubojstvo
programme.desc: Zamjenici šerifovog odjela okruga Riverside dolaze kod napuštenog vozila u udaljenom području brda Gavilan. Istražitelji su šokirani otkrićem okrutnih leševa dvojice muškaraca naguranih u prtljažnik automobila.

programme.title: Ubojstvo u motelu, Ludo ubojstvo
programme.desc: Zamjenici šerifovog odjela okruga Riverside dolaze kod napuštenog vozila u udaljenom području brda Gavilan. Istražitelji su šokirani otkrićem okrutnih leševa dvojice muškaraca naguranih u prtljažnik automobila.

programme.title: Ubojice zelenih očiju, Joshua Webb
programme.desc: U srpnju 2018. Marshall Ratliff smrtno je ustrijelio 33-godišnjeg Joshuu Webba na rampi za invalidska kolica stambenog kompleksa u središtu Beckleyja u Zapadnoj Virginiji. Pucnjava u ranim jutarnjim satima duboko je potresla lokalnu zajednicu.

programme.title: Prvih 48 sati, serija
programme.desc: Kad je mladić ubijen na zabavi u parku u okrugu Gwinnett, detektivi se obraćaju obiteljima žrtve i mogućeg osumnjičenika u nadi da će netko progovoriti.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Nakon što nasilna tučnjava rezultira time da su dvojica muškaraca brutalno izrešetani, detektivi iz Mobilea moraju pratiti više osumnjičenika kako bi shvatili što se dogodilo. Bez očevica, tužiteljstvo se oslanja na optuženike da otkriju istinu.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Nakon masovne tučnjave povezane s bandama izvan noćnog kluba, detektivi iz okruga Gwinnett nastoje identificirati tko je pucao u mladu žrtvu ubojstva. A smrt jednog od svjedoka dodatno otežava izazov za tužitelje.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Nakon masovne tučnjave povezane s bandama izvan noćnog kluba, detektivi iz okruga Gwinnett nastoje identificirati tko je pucao u mladu žrtvu ubojstva. A smrt jednog od svjedoka dodatno otežava izazov za tužitelje.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Nakon što je majka četvero djece ustrijeljena samo nekoliko ulica od svoje kuće, detektivi se okreću njezinim najbližima kako bi identificirali njezinog ubojicu. No, na suđenju, njegovi odvjetnici tvrde da je djelovao u samoobrani.

programme.title: Nakon prvih 48 sati
programme.desc: Kada je ranjiva žena upucana, svjedoci oklijevaju pomoći detektivima iz Tulse da razriješe slučaj. Na suđenju, obrana dovodi u pitanje njihovu pouzdanost i tvrdi da je tužiteljstvo optužilo pogrešnog čovjeka.

programme.title: Suncem obasjana ubojstva
programme.desc: Kada se poruke za dvoje bogatih ljubitelja sunca počnu gomilati u njihovom luksuznom hotelu u Acapulcu, policija izviđa područje - ali ključni trag dolazi iz pisma poslanog kući.

programme.title: Suncem obasjana ubojstva
programme.desc: Nestanak mladog njemačkog putnika s ruksakom iz malog grada u australskoj divljini nije izolirani slučaj. Da li serijski ubojica lovi turiste?

programme.title: Ubojstvo u motelu, Lažna uzbuna ubojice
programme.desc: Brian Redding, 32, obavještava lokalnu policiju da je pronašao svoju 16-godišnju djevojku, Cypress Noonan, mrtvu u njihovoj sobi u motelu Forest u Ridgelandu, Južna Karolina.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Isprva se mislilo da je Shele Danishefsky Covlin, uspješna financijska direktorica u New Yorku, slučajno umrla u kadi u prosincu 2009. Međutim, sumnje u vezi s njezinim otuđenim suprugom počele su izlaziti na površinu i dovele do njezina tijela.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Kristen Gilbert
programme.desc: Stopa smrtnosti misteriozno se utrostručuje na jednom odjelu bolnice u Massachusettsu. Kada istražitelji povežu činjenice, pronađu zajednički nazivnik u skrbi pacijenata - medicinsku sestru Kristen Gilbert. Ali može li ona zaista biti ubojica?

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Elizabeth Wettlaufer
programme.desc: Nevjerojatna priča o kanadskoj medicinskoj sestri serijskom ubojici, koja svojom voljom ulazi u policijsku postaju i priznaje ubojito divljanje. Njezino detaljno prepričavanje svake smrti je jezivo.

programme.title: Ubojice zelenih očiju, Cyan Maroney
programme.desc: U listopadu 2011. Jeremy Lambert brutalno je izbo i ubio svoju bivšu djevojku Cyan Maroney, 25-godišnju profesionalnu balerinu, u njezinu stanu u Beckleyju u Zapadnoj Virginiji.

programme.title: Ubojice zelenih očiju, Brooklyn Sims
programme.desc: Dana 11. kolovoza 2023., 18-godišnja Brooklyn Sims radila je svoju smjenu u trgovini Home Depot u Pensacoli kada je njezin bivši dečko, Keith Agee, doputovao iz Alabame i ušao u trgovinu. Iako je Sims prekinula vezu, Agee je postao opsjednut njome.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Jennifer Hall
programme.desc: Mala bolnica u Chillicotheu, Missouri, imala je 18 hitnih slučajeva srčanog zastoja i devet sumnjivih smrti u samo četiri mjeseca. Sumnja pada na novoimenovanog respiratornog terapeuta, što dovodi do kriminalističke istrage koja traje desetljećima.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Michael Swango
programme.desc: Lijepi doktor koji je osvajao mnoge koje je upoznao, lažljivac i prevarant, ubojica. Dr. Michael Swango ostavio je trag razaranja u SAD-u i Africi. Pravi broj žrtava smatra se da se broji u desecima.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Megan Haines
programme.desc: Kad Charli Darragh kaže majci da se požali na postupanje prema Meggan Haines, medicinskoj sestri u domu za njegu u Novom Južnom Walesu, Australija, nikad nije ni pomislila da će to dovesti do majčine smrti.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Roger Dean
programme.desc: Jedanaest ranjivih i starijih stanovnika staračkom doma u Sydneyju nastradalo je u razornom požaru. Medicinski tehničar Roger Dean pomaže u evakuaciji. No, njegova uloga u ovom tragičnom događaju je mnogo veća od same pomoći.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, John Brown
programme.desc: Kad je muškarac pronađen mrtav u motelu u San Diegu, bez jedne noge, policija isprva vjeruje da je riječ o prometnoj nesreći. No dokazi ubrzo bacaju sumnju na umiješanost dr. Johna Browna, ilegalnog kirurga za promjenu spola.

programme.title: Netko nešto skriva
programme.desc: Nakon što je 35-godišnji tetovirer Adam Young nestao, jedini trag o njegovom boravištu je snimka nadzorne kamere od 20. studenog 2017. na kojoj izlazi iz svoje stambene zgrade u centru Calgaryja s, čini se, dvojicom svojih prijatelja.

programme.title: Netko nešto skriva

programme.title: Netko nešto skriva
programme.desc: Walter Zucchetti bio je bezbrižan neženja koji je samo pokušavao živjeti svoj život. Zato je svima bilo teško povjerovati da bi itko mogao nauditi toj dobroj duši kada je 66-godišnjak pronađen mrtav u svom stanu, s crvenom trakom preko usta.

programme.title: Netko nešto skriva
programme.desc: Dvadesetčetverogodišnja Natalie Mirabal nestaje nakon kasnonoćnog odlaska u trgovinu. Kada je njezino tijelo otkriveno u obližnjem klancu, obezglavljeno, policija počinje shvaćati da netko iz njezina najužeg kruga zna nešto o tome što se dogodilo.

programme.title: Suncem obasjana ubojstva
programme.desc: Christine Barbara Rudnicki nestala pri šetnji zaljevom Tumon u Guamu. Kasnije otkrivaju njezino teško pretučeno tijelo s jasnim tragovima seksualnog napada. Vlasti sumnjaju da je serijski silovatelj i sada ubojica na slobodi u njihovoj zajednici.

programme.title: Suncem obasjana ubojstva
programme.desc: Mladi uspješni poslovni čovjek napušta sve kako bi putovao svijetom. Ali kada izgubi kontakt, njegova se obitelj ubrzo pribojava najgoreg. Bez dokaza ili osumnjičenika, može li se riješiti misterij iza njegovog boravišta prije nego što bude prekasno?

programme.title: Ubojstvo u motelu, Slučajan susret
programme.desc: Baltimore, MD. Policijski službenici odgovaraju na dojavu o preminulom muškarcu pronađenom u Deluxe Plaza Motelu u sjeveroistočnom Baltimoreu. Žrtvu, veterana američke mornarice Edwarda Yesaitisa, otkrila je ekipa za čišćenje motela.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Ubojstvo Afrikke Hardy u listopadu 2014. bilo je jezivi katalizator za istragu koja je u konačnici razotkrila gnusne zločine koje je počinio Darren Deon Vann. Afrikka, 19-godišnja žena, postala je žrtva Vannove predatorske taktike.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Efren Saldivar
programme.desc: Medicinska sestra koja voli nositi bijeli mantil liječnika nalazi se u središtu misterioznih smrti mnogih pacijenata u Glendale Adventist medicinskom centru u Kaliforniji. Čak ni njegova šokantna priznanja ne uspijevaju dovesti ga pred pravdu.

programme.title: Ubojstvo od strane liječnika, Victorino Chua
programme.desc: Bolnica u kaosu, policijske snage koje gledaju u krivom smjeru: kako je jedna medicinska sestra prevarila vlasti da izazove razaranje i smrt petljajući s vrećicama fiziološke otopine u bolnici Stepping Hill u Stockportu.

programme.title: Ubojice zelenih očiju, Ana Abulaban
programme.desc: Ali Abulaban smrtno je ustrijelio svoju suprugu od koje je bio razdvojen, Anu Abulaban, i njezina prijatelja Rayburna Barrona u stanu na visokom katu zgrade. Tužitelji su dvostruko ubojstvo opisali kao konačan ishod teškog obiteljskog nasilja.

programme.title: Ubojice zelenih očiju, Donasia Alexus Holloway
programme.desc: Dana 22. svibnja 2021., Donasiju Holloway do kuće je pratio njezin bivši dečko, Justin Cole Carroll. Primijetivši Carrollov kamionet, Holloway je radi sigurnosti parkirala pokraj policijskog vozila te ga snimila putem Snapchata.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Godine 1990., Dolly Hearn, studentica stomatologije i bivša djevojka Barta Corbina, pronađena je mrtva u svom stanu u Augusti, Georgia, što je isprva proglašeno samoubojstvom.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Denita Smith, 25-godišnja studentica postdiplomskog studija u Sjevernoj Karolini, ubijena je 4. siječnja 2007. Prije svoje tragične smrti, Shannon Crawley, koja je imala kompliciranu povijest s Denitinim zaručnikom, postala je iznimno ljubomorna.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Ubojstvo Cari Farver odigralo se usred složene mreže ljubomore i opsesije u njezinim vezama s Davidom Kroupom i Shannom "Liz" Golyar. Cari je misteriozno nestala nakon što je napustila Davidov stan, što je izazvalo sumnjive SMS poruke.

programme.title: Nesavršeno ubojstvo
programme.desc: Rozanne Gailiunas i njezin suprug Peter sele se u grad Richardson u Texasu kako bi živjeli savršen život. Ali kada brak postane kompliciran i ljubavni trokut ispliva na površinu, Rozanne završi mrtva.

The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Forests are crucial for our survival on Earth. They absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and supply all living forms with clean oxygen. "We are like a patient in a hospital bed that is turning down their oxygen tank and thinking they could live with a little bit less oxygen and meanwhile the CO2 is increasing in the room" says journalist Andrew Nikiforuk.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The Drakelow Tunnels are a former underground military complexused mainly for storage. However, during the construction and running of this facility, 6 people are thought to have died. It is believed most of the hauntings that occur here are from the very people that died here.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Team members Patricia Marin and Malinka Franklin help a lost soul cross over into the light.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: What In the World

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: This episode of Desperate Hours is all about disasters at sea. The long saga of death and misadventure at sea is as much a record of human folly as it is of nature's fury. When you start charting a course through the choppy seas of maritime disasters, the effect can be quite sobering. From the loss of the Titanic, a supposedly unsinkable luxury liner; to a routine ferry trip in South Korea that ended with the heart-breaking loss of so many young lives. Or how about the Exxon Valdez oil spoil, which pumped millions of gallons of crude oil into Prince William Sound, Alaska, one of the last pristine environments on earth? Then there is the return of piracy to the high seas _ not as a masquerade, but as a clear and present danger. That old saying "worse things happen at sea"? Well, it turns out, they really do.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: And we're off! We learn the history of the world famous Kentucky Derby. Then, call your shot as we learn about one of America's most famous brands, Louisville Slugger. Also, we zip line in the world's only underground zip line attraction and visit the Ali Center.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: The Saints come marching in as we tour the iconic St. Louis Cathedral and the mysterious Ursuline Convent in New Orleans. We delve into Mardi Gras history at Mardi Gras World and visit the National WWII Museum's world class collection.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling for Chinook Salmon in Prince Rupert then making big run Southbound to Hartley Bay through Grenville Channel!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: The desert of Gujarat is hardly the place one expects to encounter a lion, but in the scrub forest of the region Bill does exactly that. Join him as he tracks the lion and many less dangerous creatures from spotted deer to owls and parrots. Around the campfire at night meet the local dance group who is preserving the traditional dances of the area people. A unique experience in a unique region.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Over the years, Bill has been able to find and film all of the great predators of India, but one—the wild Asiatic Dog or Dhole. These illusive and endangered canines have rarely been captured on camera. This is the last great wildlife challenge Bill has yet to conquer…Will he succeed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya and one of the most fascinating cities in Africa. On our visit we'll see the colonial architecture of a bygone era and the ultra-modern side of town as well. We'll learn the truth behind the "Out of Africa" story and our host gets eye-to-eye with some endangered giraffes.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Amboseli National Park has had several years of drought so we're anxious to see if the famous elephant herds are healthy. Journeys takes to the air and ground to get a count of these incredible animals. Along the way, we visit the local Masai to see how they're adjusting to encroaching civilization and we encounter buffalo, hippos and numerous bird species that make Amboseli so special.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A group of pro skiers travel a tough journey to South America in the hopes of experiencing the world-renown ski terrain Las Lenas, Argentina.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A world-class group of skiers explore epic backcountry terrain around Bralorne, B.C., areas accessible only by snowmobiles, with Canadian sled super-heroes as their guides.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Exoplanets, Thousands Of New Worlds
programme.desc: Are we alone in the universe? This question has been one of the greatest mysteries of all time. 20 years ago, individual scientists began to challenge traditional planetary science as they set off to seek, observe and reveal the existence of unknown worlds: EXOPLANETS. The film recounts the epic journey of these astrophysicists, who turned our knowledge of the universe upside down, in their quest for extraterrestrial life.

programme.title: Wax in the City
programme.desc: Africa is in fashion! Its flag? Wax print, which more and more Franco-African designers are choosing to incorporate into their creations. Flora Coquerel, a Franco-Beninese woman and the winner of MissFrance 2014, invites us to follow them in their intense and globalised life for a success story _ how the colours of a simple fabric have become the symbol of the cultural melting pot of an entire generation!

programme.title: Boteti: The Returning River
programme.desc: For 20 years the Boteti River in northern Botswana lay dry, leaving wildlife dependent on a handful of shrinking rain pools. Then, after decades of drought, heavy rains in the Angolan highlands send water flowing once more. Boteti _ The Returning River captures this dramatic rebirth, revealing how animals endured the harsh years and how the river's return transforms the landscape. Filmed over two years in stunning HD, the film documents rare behavior, explosive life, and the renewal of an entire ecosystem.

programme.title: The Ettore Majorana Mystery, An Absolute Physicist
programme.desc: The life and genius of Ettore Majorana, remains a source of fascination nearly 80 years after his mysterious disappearance in 1938. This Italian physicist pushed the boundaries of Quantum Physics and Cosmology and made a huge contribution to the understanding of the Nucleus, dark matter and its disappearance. As Science and History are intimately linked, could this be one of the reasons for Majorana's disappearance? An investigative novel and a scientific thriller in troubled decade of the 1930's in a world of the birth of the Atomic bomb.

programme.title: Carnival Of the Two Shores
programme.desc: Cuba and La Palma (Canary Islands), two islands joined together by the same ocean, celebrate their twinning with a unique festivity in which all participants dress in white and dust each other to the beats of sounds, guajiras and guarachas. It is "Los Indianos" Carnival, a wonderful experience with authentic Caribbean flavour.

programme.title: Carnival Of the Two Shores
programme.desc: Cuba and La Palma (Canary Islands), two islands joined together by the same ocean, celebrate their twinning with a unique festivity in which all participants dress in white and dust each other to the beats of sounds, guajiras and guarachas. It is "Los Indianos" Carnival, a wonderful experience with authentic Caribbean flavour.

programme.title: Last Call for Titan
programme.desc: Join this immersive journey to one of the last unchartered planet of our solar system, the sixth and largest moon of Saturn : TITAN. 12 years ago, after a 7-year-long interplanetary journey the Cassini-Huygens spacecraft marked history with the first landing ever accomplished in the outer Solar system, reaching Titan's surface. Based on the observations and data collected by the probe and the orbiter all through these years this film uses the latest light and sound simulation techniques to interpret visually for the first time the spectacle which has been hiding behind Saturn's dust cloud.

programme.title: Evita
programme.desc: She was considered the most powerful woman of her time. Together with Juan Domingo Perón she formed a legendary partnership that was a mixture of both fairy tale and of political struggle. The trajectory of a figure that inspired both unconditional love, and bitter hatred, and who, decades after her death, continues to influence Argentine politics.

programme.title: Yemen, Chaos in Silence
programme.desc: After three years of war, Yemen is facing its worst humanitarian crisis since the end of World War II. Yemen, "chaos in silence" is an unprecedented journey that tells the story of a conflict that is unfolding virtually without outside witnesses. From Aden in the south to Sanaa in the north, via Taez, the front line, this film explores a devastated country, eroded by political and religious divisions and ravaged by cholera.

programme.title: Life Is One
programme.desc: The return to life in the wild for 3 captive sun bears.

programme.title: Legendary Bandits of Mexico
programme.desc: Bandidos Legendarios is a documentary based in four mythical Mexican bandits, trying to find out why they became legendary. They are Joaquin Murrieta, Chucho el Roto, Los Plateados y Heraclio Bernal. Going through the key places where historical facts happened along with historians and specialists, each episode narrates the life of these bandits, trying to find the answers to the great questions that build the myth.

programme.title: Aramburus Assassination
programme.desc: July, 1st 1970, though Pindapoy operation, Montoneros guerrilla group assassinated Lieutenant General Pedro Aramburu, who in 1955 lead the power grab against General Perón. Constructed as a police drama, Aramburu's Assassination recreates previous scenes to the execution and studies Argentinean left wing guerillas 40 years after their appearance.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Westward ho! We settle in Salt Lake City, where we learn about Bringham Young's settlement of the Utah territory and his monument at This is the Place Park. Then we dig in the dirt to find hundreds of perfectly preserved dinosaurs at the Utah Natural History museum. We'll take a look at some US aviation history at the Hill Air force Base museum, and see how life was like for the Utah pioneers at Frontier Homestead State Park.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: TTH heads to the great white North…kind of. We visit the world class city of Toronto. There we'll head straight up the Western Hemisphere's tallest structure, the CN Tower. Next we score a look at the Hockey Hall of Fame and see a North American castle at Casa Loma. Finally we see how the British defended their city against the newly formed United States at Fort York.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Humpback Whales, perfect water, summer sunshine and one of the finest fishing Chinook Salmon solo fishing days!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Just north of India is a land steeped in mystery—Nepal. Bill tours the city of Kathmandu, visits the World Heritage temple complexes, and walks along the city streets, where ancient and modern vie for space. We fly around Mount Everest, arguably the world's most famous mountain, before heading into Chitwan National Park. In Chitwan, Bill searches for tigers from the back of an elephant and observes the myriad of wildlife that call the park home.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no figure in Indian history that rivals Gandhi. Bill explores the land Gandhi called home and in the process, learns about the man himself. But Ahmedabad is more than Gandhi…its rich history and unusual architecture is revealed.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This is definitely the land of the elephant. Large herds of pachyderms roam this marshy park putting on a show for whoever wants to watch. But that's not the only big boys of this park—buffalo, lion and a host of hoofed game make this a wonder to behold.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This under-visited, and far western Kenyan park area, is renowned for its giant flamingo gatherings that literally turn lakes pink. We explore these many parks on foot, in a safari vehicle and on horseback searching out the local legends that have marked this region the death zone. Our host faces imminent doom in three unique parks in this fast-paced episode.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Explore the windsurfing culture of Maui, and follow a Production Company as they make a Windsurfing movie. The serene island is the perfect backdrop for this sun, sea and surf extravaganza.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A look at the characters and destinations for heli-skiers in Alaska.

As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. programme.title: China Uncovered
programme.desc: Despite the constant looming threat of globalization, some beloved old traditions, like the Szechuan chili and hotpots are still mainstays in Chinese culture. But while some traditions thrive, some face big challenges. A rare look at the enigma of Tibet shows a culture approaching a crossroads. Even the iconic pandas are dwindling if not for the aggressive breeding programs. Will old traditions stand a chance against the steam-rolling speeds and force of the new world?

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: Forty years after the end of the conflict, unexploded bombs, secret tunnels and other vestiges of the long combat still exist in Vietnam.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: This unconventional road trip follows the "Local Exposure Tour," in search of the next BMX pro rider. It follows some of the biggest names in BMX as they search for a BMX "grom" deserving of the opportunity of a lifetime.

programme.title: Hidden Traces
programme.desc: "D-DAY" _ June 6th 1944: Normandy landings Personal and daily items such as helmets, badges, bullets, weapons, cans have been uncovered by recent archeological digs. These traces left behind by soldiers and civilians on the battle ground and findings of underground passages and blockhouses kept secret provide new insights into 2WW History.

programme.title: The Day When...
programme.desc: Hitler's downfall began before the official end of the war in 1945. Specifically, on June 22, 1941. Hitler launched the largest military offensive in history _ against the USSR in Operation Barbarossa.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Go for launch! We visit Space Shuttle Endeavor at the California Science Center. Then, we check out the glitch and glamour at the Hollywood Museum. We'll learn about the Holocaust at the Holocaust Museum and Japanese Internment during WWII at the Japanese/American National Museum. After that, we dig for bones at the famous La Brea Tar Pits.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: Up, up and away! We discover St. Petersburg Florida's aviation roots at the St.Pete History Museum. Then, comb your mustache, we visit the Dali Museum to look at Salvador Dali's amazing masterworks. We'll dredge the deep looking for sponges, and defend the bay at Fort Desoto.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Journey inside Dust Storms to see how they are formed and the hazards and effects they cause. A glimpse into the science of Clouds and how they fit into the weather cycle of the planet. The power of Lightening is more than visual, it is noise, electricity and it even helps plants to grow. Did you know that Rain droplets have different shapes and temperatures, it's maybe more interesting than you think?

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Running Southbound outside on Central Coast with a big Tyee Chinook Release finish North of Milbanke Sound!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Chennai, formerly known as Madras, can trace its roots back to a tiny fishing village. Bill explores the city's growth under the British East India Company, with visits to Fort St. George and the Fort Museum. We then travel to the nearby Sao Tome Basilica, the church and burial site of St. Thomas the Apostle. In Pondicherry, French influences can still be felt in the tree-lined streets, colonial mansions and cafés. Its beautiful setting on the Bay of Bengal makes Pondicherry a delightful place to spend the day. We also visit the ancient port city of Mahabalipuram, where the landscape is dominated by carved-stone architecture. The final highlight of our tour is the Descent of Ganga, which is the world's largest bas-relief carving.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: There is no city in India that is more British than Calcutta. The former capital of British India, Calcutta has gardens, buildings and museums to prove it. Throw away any ideas you have of this giant city and discover the treasures it holds.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: This ancient ruined city, lost to history, was one of the most powerful in the world during its prime. The architectural sophistication and sheer size will amaze. Then Journeys heads out to the deep ocean for some big game fishing. Will we land the big one or return empty handed?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: This episode will follow "Team Cannondale" riders as they explore the European Alps, and all it has to offer for the mountain bike culture.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Kitesurfing is a sport that could not be better suited to an island location like Tahiti. With the sun, sand and an ocean breeze it is an ideal spot to spread your kite and surf.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: There's no doubt sharks have an image problem. And they're certainly in trouble globally. The population of some species has declined by more than 90% due to over fishing. But there's still one place in the world where sharks thrive _ the Bahamas. Sharks not only prosper there, they are highly protected. It's illegal to kill them. Stuart Cove's passion is sharks. Travelling In his private plane, he spreads the gospel of shark advocacy across the Bahamian island chain. And shark tourism is his livelihood. A successful entrepreneur, his main business revolves around scuba diving with sharks. Cove also works with Bahamian and international researchers in their studies of dangerous species such as tiger, hammerhead and bull sharks.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan heads down to the shipwrecks of North Carolina (USA) to observe how these wrecks have become home to thousands of animals, including Sand Tiger sharks. But instead of chasing all the fish, the sharks are protecting many of them! Then, Jonathan visits the School for Field Studies in the Turks & Caicos Islands to learn how college students conduct fieldwork in their pursuit of degrees in Marine Studies. He helps tag sharks, study conch and investigate marine protected areas!

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In a shark-filled adventure, Jonathan travels to the Bahamas to meet Neal Harvey, a world-renown shark handler who will attempt to teach Jonathan how to put Caribbean Reef sharks into a relaxed state known as tonic immobility! Then, Jonathan heads to NASA's Neutral Buoyancy Lab in Houston, Texas (USA), where astronauts train for space walking underwater, in a giant pool about half the size of a soccer field. Jonathan gets a rare and fascinating look into this high-tech diving as he ventures underwater with the astronauts.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Radar accurate eyes survey the land, slotted feathers adjust flight paths as falcons attack, pelicans soar, kestrels hover, owls silently fly, parrots flock, vultures swarm and eagles swoop. Which is the true Master of the Sky? Peregrine Falcon _ Revered for speed and power, this raptor was favored by ancient falconers. Budgie _ Bright green and yellow budgies light up Australia's skies in lively flocks. Wedge-tailed Eagle _ Australia's largest bird of prey commands awe with its soaring presence. Pelican _ Graceful giants of the sky, pelicans glide in formation on rising thermals. Seabirds _ Nearly 300 species live between sea and air, truly free in their vast domain. Barn Owl _ Mysterious and wise, the barn owl watches silently from the shadows. Vulture _ Africa's plains are scanned by vultures, nature's cleanup crew. Nankeen Kestrel _ Australia's smallest falcon, elegant and inquisitive, glides over open land.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The colossal elephant. The lush tropical forests of Asia hold within them some of nature's mightiest creatures.Each of these silent footsteps carries with it the immense weight of the world's largest land mammal. The intimidating birds with soaring grace and aerial prowess, birds dominate our skies. To remain the undisputed pioneers of the air most bird species are feather light and relatively small. The barrel-like Hippo Lumbering across land, the enormity of the barrel like hippo is without question. Other grass eaters are frail by comparison. The towering giraffe standing taller than any other living animal in their towering majesty is the proud and elegant giraffe. The gigantic whale the Mighty whale graces our oceans with a size and strength unrivalled on land. Three times longer than the tallest giraffe and weighing more than a dozen hippos' the beautiful humpback whale is most famed for its mystical and haunting song. Which is the biggest of them all?

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predators use speed, teeth, poison, and trickery to survive, but prey animals have evolved fascinating defenses. While fleeing is common, others use deception and chemistry—camouflage, mimicry, and toxins. Insects mimic leaves, snakes play dead, fish fly, and toads have poisonous skin. Predator-prey dynamics form an evolutionary arms race, with each side adapting to outsmart the other. Defense mechanisms include claws, poison, camouflage, and foul sprays. From zebra patterns to spider silk, strong defenses are vital to winning the Race of Life.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Most sea creatures are predators, from tiny fish to giant squid. Built to hunt and survive, they've evolved into efficient underwater war machines. Stonefish lie in wait, disguised, while sharks, barracuda, and moray eels hunt with speed and precision. Reef fish must dodge lightning-fast barracuda and graceful but deadly moray eels. Lionfish use venomous spines, and stonefish can swallow prey whole. In the ocean's depths, survival is a constant battle—an underwater jungle of razor teeth and stealthy ambushes.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Mistify - Michael Hutchence, glazbeno-dokumentarni film
programme.desc: Okusi, pomiriši, dodirni... Michael Hutchence volio je sve senzualne stvari. On je oduvijek žudio za zadovoljstvom i imao je neutaživu znatiželju, uvijek u potrazi za novim osjećajima. Široki dijapazon glasova i kućnih uradaka u ovom dokumentarcu animiraju Hutchenceovu osobnost, otkrivajući iznenađujuću priču s dubokim zanosom. Karizmatičan i ambiciozan, glavni pjevač skupine INXS jednakom strašću žudio je za obitelji kao i za umjetničkim uspjehom. Svjedočanstva ljubavi njegova života, uključujući Kylie Minogue i Helenu Christensen, kreiraju intimni portret čovjeka iza statusa boga seksa - oznake koja je istovremeno hranila njegovu popularnost, ali ga i osudila. Hutchence je imao eksplozivni magnetizam, ali također i mnogo tajni. Rušeći tabloidne spekulacije jednom zauvijek, njegova priča u dokumentarnom filmu "Mystify: Michael Hutchence" izlazi na površinu s emotivnom i razotkrivajućom dubinom.

programme.title: Velika europska putovanja željeznicom
programme.desc: Michael Portillo putuje kroz Europu kako bi razumio život tijekom Prvoga i Drugoga svjetskog rata. Na svojim putovanjima posjećuje Španjolsku, Francusku, Njemačku, Italiju, Švedsku, Austriju i Češku, učeći o starim europskim carstvima koja su nestala u revolucijama te o desetak novih nacija koje su optimistično krenule u neovisnost. Vidjet će kako je tehnologija brzo napredovala, kako su zrakoplovi i automobili povezani sa željeznicom u transportnu mrežu koja je obuhvatila cijeli svijet. Kako su jazz i kino zabavljali radne ljude koji su živjeli, radili i zabavljali se pod svjetlima velikih metropola, dok su se diljem kontinenta komunisti i fašisti borili za vlast u Europi, čiji je krhki mir ubrzo ponovno narušen ratom.

programme.title: Dvijetisućite
programme.desc: Prvo desetljeće 21. stoljeća bilo je jedno od najdramatičnijih u povijesti Amerike. 2000. započele su kontroverznim izborima, brzo su uslijedili razorni teroristički napadi 11. rujna. Kao rezultat toga, Sjedinjene Američke Države pokrenule su dva rata i usvojile neviđene sigurnosne mjere. Uragan Katrina pogodio je obalu Zaljeva 2005. godine kao najrazornija prirodna katastrofa u povijesti nacije. U 2008. godini, ekonomski je sustav padao na rub kolapsa kad su bankroti dominirali novinskim naslovima. Iste godine Amerika je izabrala svog prvog crnog predsjednika, što je izvanredno postignuće s obzirom na prošlost zemlje. Hip-hop je nastavio uspon dok je digitalni napredak, poput iPoda, poticao demokratizaciju američke glazbe. Televizija je ušla u „drugo zlatno doba i možda su najznačajnije kulturne promjene bile potaknute sazrijevanjem Interneta i pojavom društvenih mreža, pri čemu web stranice poput Facebooka mijenjaju načine na koji komuniciramo.

programme.title: Velika putovanja željeznicom kroz Veliku Britaniju
programme.desc: Sezonu po sezonu, pridružujemo se Michaelu Portillu dok putuje željeznicom uzduž i poprijeko Velike Britanije, istražujući povijest nacije i prateći ogromne društvene, političke i kulturne promjene koje su tijekom godina željeznice donijele sa sobom. Otkrivamo kako je Britanija oblikovana rastućom mrežom povijesnih željeznica, s fascinantnim uvidima i likovima na svakoj stanici na putu. Uvijek informativan i često dirljiv, serijal Željeznička putovanja nastavlja oduševljavati i zabavljati publiku diljem svijeta.

programme.title: Skrivena nacifikacija svijeta, strani dokumentarni program
programme.desc: Uz pomoć arhiva i originalnih spisa, ova dokumentarna serija nam otkriva kako je preko 900 000 nacista pobjeglo pravdi i živjelo slobodno diljem svijeta kao da se ništa nije dogodilo. Zaposleni od stranih nacija u širokom spektru poslova, ali i špijuna, potajno su širili i slijedili Hitlerov san - potpunu nacifikaciju svijeta.

programme.title: Putovanje vremenom - Put života
programme.desc: Najljepši dokumentarac o svemiru ikad snimljen. Prošlost, sadašnjost, budućnost. Svjedočite rođenju vremena, putovanje počinje u trenutku Big Banga do današnjeg vremena, a nudi i mali uvid u budućnost svemira. Kroz niz nevjerojatnih prikaza pokušava dokučiti postanak našeg svemira, a s njim i apstraktnog pojma kakvo je vrijeme. Koristi se materijal koji je Malick skupljao punih 30 godina, a prezenterica je australska oskarovka Cate Blanchett. Dox je zapravo popratni materijal za Malickov film Drvo života koji je 2011. osvojio Zlatnu palmu u Cannesu.

programme.title: Posljednji divovi
programme.desc: „Posljednji divovi dokumentarni je serijal koji nas vodi u adrenalinske misije pune akcije u potrazi za hladnim planinskim titanima 'Velikog sjevera' i golijatima iz džungle Amazone. Svrha je spasiti vrste kojima prijeti izumiranje, ali Cyril Chauquet i njegov tim također moraju preživjeti ekstremne opasnosti dok traže legendarne divove koji postoje desecima milijuna godina, ali koje su lov i okolišni čimbenici doveli u opasnost. Traže ogromnu, oklopljenu bijelu jesetru, prapovijesnog Pirarucua i jednog od najugroženijih slatkovodnih golijata na planetu: ogromnu Piraibu. To je ekstremna avantura ali očuvanje i ekstremni ribolov njihova su strast što je od vitalnog značaja ako žele spasiti neke ugrožene vrste.

programme.title: Bijeg na selo
programme.desc: Bijeg u unutrašnjost vraća se s novom serijom potraga za savršenim domom obitelji koje žele pobjeći od života u gradu. Svaka epizoda prikazuje par ili obitelj koja razmišlja o bijegu i selidbi u ruralnu Englesku.

programme.title: Frajeri
programme.desc: "Frajeri" je prekrasno snimljen, vješto napravljen dokumentarac o životu u opakom pariškom predgrađu Aulnay-sous-Bois, prikazan kroz oči jedanaestero srednjoškolaca, od kojih su većina francuski državljani prve generacije. Govoreći izravno pred kamerom ovi izvanredni mladi ljudi govore o ljubavi, o tome kako je biti Francuz, životu na periferiji i njihovim vizijama budućnosti. „Frajeri zavodi ne samo zrelošću, velikodušnošću i iskrenošću ovih mladih ljudi, već naporima filmaša da ga podigne iz prosjeka uključivanjem šarmantnih letova fantazija koji ilustriraju dječje neizgovorene snove. „Frajeri je mnogo više od još jednog dokumentarnog filma o dječijoj otpornosti u izazovnim okolnostima.

programme.title: Frajeri
