programme.title: Strah i trepet u avionu
programme.desc: Od diOd suludih agresivnih putnika do prinudnih sletanja, ekstremnih turbulencija i bočnih vetrova, naši snimci će šokirati gledaoce i osvetliti trenutke užasa, kada čuju iz prve ruke šta se to tačno dogodilo. Oni će pokazati da je i na najgorim mogućim letovima, uprkos opasnostima, moguće izvući se bez povrede.

programme.title: Najveće inženjerske katastrofe
programme.desc: Inženjeri pomeraju granice inovacija, vodeći čovečanstvo ka našim najvećim dostignućima. Njihovi neuspesi su trenuci nalik Ikarovom padu, kada preterivanje, prekidi u komunikaciji i kobne pogrešne procene mogu koštati milione dolara, odnose živote i unazađuju napredak čovečanstva. Ova serija putuje širom sveta, od SAD-a, Velike Britanije, Rusije, Haitija i drugih zemalja, otkrivajući najveće neuspehe modernog inženjeringa kroz pažljivo istražene arhivske snimke, stručne analize, potresne intervjue sa svedocima i vrhunske grafičke prikaze. Istražujemo događaje i činjenice iza zloglasnih imena poput Fukušime, Exxon Valdeza, Grenfell Tauer-a i Three Mile Island-a, otkrivajući fatalne greške i nove teorije o tome zašto su se te katastrofe dogodile. Takođe otkrivamo kako tragedija može podstaći izume i napredak. Kako istorijski događaji poput eksplozije naftne platforme Piper Alpha, urušavanja rudnika San Hose u Čileu i uništenja Space Shuttle-a Columbia primoravaju inženjere da se suoče sa smrtonosnim greškama i stvore svetliju, sigurniju budućnost?

programme.title: CIA: iza kulisa 11. septembra
programme.desc: 11. septembar 2001. godine: prvi napad na američkom tlu još od Perl Harbora. Nakon napada, CIA, kojoj je Bela kuća poverila rukovođenje odzivom na napad, pretvorila se u paravojnu organizaciju sa ovlašćenjima bez presedana: ukloniti terorističku pretnju svim raspoloživim sredstvima. Od munjevite invazije na Avganistan 2001. godine do ponižavajućeg povratka talibana 2021, od ubistva Bin Ladena 2011, do uspona ISIS-a 2014, pa sve do nadrealnog rukovanja Trampa sa nekadašnjim vođom Al Kaide koji je postao predsednik Sirije 2025. godine, bivši špijuni, oficiri, analitičari i direktori najveće obaveštajne agencije na svetu prekidaju ćutanje i otkrivaju unutrašnje mehanizme ovog tajnog rata. Kroz retka, u nekim slučajevima i nikada ranije objavljena svedočenja pre svega pripadnika američkih obaveštajnih službi, ova serija prodire u samo srce tajnih operacija koje su uzdrmale temelje najstarije demokratije na svetu. Pokazuje kako je potraga za bezbednošću uvela Ameriku, ali i čitav svet, u novo doba. Ovo je serija koja otvara vrata fascinantnog sveta iza kulisa, prožetog tajnama i protivrečnostima.

programme.title: Korzikanska mafija: Kodeks ćutanja
programme.desc: Korzika, početak 1980-ih. Uspon jednog klana, sa sedištem u gradu Bastiji, uspostavlja vladavinu terora na francusko ostrvo. Ubrzo klan postaje jedna od najvećih banditskih grupa u zemlji. Ovo je mitska priča o korzikanskim gangsterima La Brise de Mer (Morski povetarac). Zastrašivanje, pranje novca, pljačke, ubistva… Tokom 30 godina, članovi La Brise de Mer vladali su ostrvom. Gomilanjem sve većeg broja investicija, nemilosrdnim uklanjanjem svake konkurencije i sklapanjem saveza s političarima i poslovnim ljudima, ova mafijaška grupa je postepeno izgradila svoje carstvo. Novac je tekao slobodno, a princip nekažnjivosti je dostigao perfekciju. Naime, pred La Brise de Mer svi su poštovali zakon ćutanja… Od ubistva korzikanskog kuma Luja Memija 1982. godine, preko niza spektakularnih pljački i bekstava, do unutrašnjeg rata između dvojice njenih predvodnika _ Ričarda Kazanove i Fransisa Marijanija _ ova true crime serija prati putanju jedne nemilosrdne i legendarne mafijaške grupe. Zanimljiva saga koja kombinuje arhivske snimke, rekonstrukcije i svedočenja bivših gangstera, pravnika, policajaca i novinara.

programme.title: Ubistvo na internetu
programme.desc: Prva epizoda dvodelnog serijala Ubistvo na internetu donosi priče o najšokantnijim opasnostima kad je u pitanju traženje ljubavi na internetu, ispričane zahvaljujući policijskim arhivama i razgovorima s prijateljima, porodicama, policijom, advokatima, psiholozima i stručnjacima za ljubavne sastanke. Serijski ubica i silovatelj Stiven Port koristio je veliki broj ljubavnih veb sajtova i aplikacija kako bi namamio mlade muškarce u svoj stan u Barkingu, gde ih je trovao smrtonosnim dozama droge GBH, nakon čega ih je nesvesne silovao. A tu je i Karl Langdel, koji se predstavljao kao uspešni biznismen preko društvenih mreža, a zapravo je od ranije bio poznat policiji kao mentalni bolesnik. On je razgovarao s 23-godišnjom Kejti Lok na sajtu "Plenty of Fish" pre dogovaranja sastanka u Šordiču, u Londonu. Manje od 24 sata kasnije, njeno telo je bačeno u grmlje na imanju hotela u kom je Langdel zadavio školsku učiteljicu, nakon čega je s njom imao seksualni odnos, što je zabeležio i fotoaparatom. Treća priča se tiče serijskog silovatelja Džejsona Loransa, koji je koristio svoje profile bez slike kako bi kontaktirao na hiljade žena na sajtu match.com. Nakon toga bi komunicirao s ženama preko privatnih poruka ili mejla, mameći žrtve što dalje od bezbednosnih procedura koje se zahtevaju na tom sajtu. Kada bi na kraju i lično upoznao žrtve, agresivno bi im se nabacivao. Poslednji je slučaj 20-godišnjeg Amerikanca, Šejna Kofija, koji je prešao 5.000 kilometara avionom preko Atlantika kako bi se osvetio svojoj 18-godišnjoj poznanici s interneta, koja je okončala njihovu vezu na daljinu. Par se upoznao zahvaljujući ljubavi prema video igrama. Provalio joj je u sobu kroz prozor i napao je lovačkim nožem, u jednom do detalja isplaniranom napadu.

programme.title: Ubistvo na internetu
programme.desc: U drugoj epizodi dvodelnog serijala Ubistvo na internetu pratimo priče o najšokantnijim opasnostima kad je u pitanju traženje ljubavi na internetu, ispričane zahvaljujući policijskim arhivama i razgovorima s prijateljima, porodicama, policijom, advokatima, psiholozima i stručnjacima za ljubavne sastanke. Prvi slučaj se tiče 27-godišnjeg Luka Harloua, koji je upoznao 15-godišnju gimnazijalku iz Lestera, Kejli Hejvud, preko Fejzbuka. Nakon što su razmenili 2.600 poruka tokom 13 dana, pozvao je Kejli u svoj stan. Kejli je rekla roditeljima da će preko vikenda ostati kod drugarice, iako je zapravo bila u stanu serijskog pedofila, Harloua. Nakon konzumiranja velike količine alkohola, upoznao ju je sa svojim susedom Stivenom Bidmanom, koji ju je silovao i ubio. Potom pratimo slučaj 50-godišnjeg Stefana Bricija, ljudoždera ubice koji je koristio aplikaciju Grajnder kako bi namamio policijskog službenika, Gordona Templa, u svoj dom, gde ga je iskasapio i rastvorio njegovo telo u kiselini. Bio je inspirisan svojom omiljenom TV serijom, "Čista hemija", u kojoj glavni lik, proizvođač kristal meta, uništava leš služeći se sličnim alatom i hemikalijama. Brici je u međuvremenu nađen mrtav u svojoj ćeliji u zatvoru Belmarš. Poslednji slučaj u ovom serijalu tiče se 35-godišnjeg Majlsa Donelija, koji je 44-godišnjoj samohranoj majci, Uši Patel, obećavao ljubavnu vezu, sve dok je nije nasilno izbo kuhinjskim nožem 13 puta. Uša Patel je upoznala Donelija na sajtu oasis.com, i nakon nekoliko meseci razmenjivanja poruka, pozvala ga je u svoj stan, gde ju je ubio. Narednog jutra, Ušinog oca je pozvao njegov unuk, Ušin sin, koji je u trenutku ubistva bio u stanu.

programme.title: Robin Hood, serija
programme.desc: Marian otkriva Robov identitet i prekida njihovu vezu. Princ John ulazi u priču s kraljevskim ambicijama dok se Marian nađe uvučena u opasnu romansu i smrtonosnu špijunsku igru ​​na dvoru.

programme.title: Bookish, serija
programme.desc: Kad se zloglasni fašist naizgled oživi, Book i Nora su namamljeni u hodnike londonskog Crnog muzeja. U međuvremenu, Trottie i Jack povezuju slučaj bijega s mjesta nesreće s vojnikom iz Velikog rata.

programme.title: Gospođica Marple, serija
programme.desc: Lik pronicljive i znatiželjne gđice Jane Marple stvorila je svjetski poznata autorica krimića Agatha Christie. Simpatična vanjština mile i drage starice skriva iznimnu sposobnost zapažanja, nevjerojatnu oštroumnost i izvanredan dar za rješavanje zločina što ubojice često podcjenjuju. U glavnoj ulozi je Julia McKenzie, sedma glumica koja se nakon Geraldine McEwan, Gracie Fields, Margaret Rutherford, Angele Lansbury, Helen Hayes i Joan Hickson okušala u interpretaciji simpatične gospođice Marple. --- Nakon što starog prijatelja gospođice Marple netko brutalno ubije nedugo nakon što joj je poštom poslao popis nepoznatih imena, ona kreće u London kako bi istražila i pronašla pravdu za svojega prijatelja. Uskoro pronalazi identičan popis imena na listu papira na kojem se spominje prenoćište Kod bijelog konja. Ona posjeti prenoćište gdje je dočeka neobična postava uposlenika i gostiju, a među njima i tri moderne vještice: Thyrza (Pauline Collins), Sybil (Susan Lynch) i Bella. Postaje jasno da je cijelo mjesto očarano crnom magijom. Nakon ubojstva ekscentričnog por. Cottama gđica Marple je prisiljena uzeti pravdu u svoje ruke.

programme.title: Obitelj Forsyte, serija
programme.desc: Jolyon Snr rewrites his will, family tensions simmer. Phil oversteps, June faces a painful realisation, and Irene attempts to break free from Soames's control.

programme.title: Gospođica Marple, serija
programme.desc: Lik pronicljive i znatiželjne gđice Jane Marple stvorila je svjetski poznata autorica krimića Agatha Christie. Simpatična vanjština mile i drage starice skriva iznimnu sposobnost zapažanja, nevjerojatnu oštroumnost i izvanredan dar za rješavanje zločina što ubojice često podcjenjuju. U glavnoj ulozi je Julia McKenzie, sedma glumica koja se nakon Geraldine McEwan, Gracie Fields, Margaret Rutherford, Angele Lansbury, Helen Hayes i Joan Hickson okušala u interpretaciji simpatične gospođice Marple. --- Nakon što starog prijatelja gospođice Marple netko brutalno ubije nedugo nakon što joj je poštom poslao popis nepoznatih imena, ona kreće u London kako bi istražila i pronašla pravdu za svojega prijatelja. Uskoro pronalazi identičan popis imena na listu papira na kojem se spominje prenoćište Kod bijelog konja. Ona posjeti prenoćište gdje je dočeka neobična postava uposlenika i gostiju, a među njima i tri moderne vještice: Thyrza (Pauline Collins), Sybil (Susan Lynch) i Bella. Postaje jasno da je cijelo mjesto očarano crnom magijom. Nakon ubojstva ekscentričnog por. Cottama gđica Marple je prisiljena uzeti pravdu u svoje ruke.

programme.title: Ubojstvo u malenom gradu, serija
programme.desc: Marie Bannister se vraća u gradić Gibsons, sa željom da se pomiri s otuđenom kćeri, ali tragično završava kad ju pronađu ubijenu u unajmljenoj kući. Albergova istraga ubrzo poprima opasan obrat.

programme.title: Sva stvorenja velika i mala, serija
programme.desc: Hvaljena adaptacija omiljene i kultne zbirke priča autora bestselera Jamesa Herriota, u produkciji Playgrounda, nagrađena BAFTA-om i Zlatnim globusom, vraća se na male ekrane. I ova će sezona nastaviti oživljavati priče Jamesa Herriota. Vraćamo se u Darrowby kako bismo se ponovno pridružili našoj nekonvencionalnoj, omiljenoj obitelji u Skeldaleu te šarolikom društvu farmera, životinja i stanovnika jorkširskih dolina 1940-ih godina. ------ U svibnju 1945. James odlazi na farmu Archieja Tredwella pomoći pri teškom janjenju, uz malog Jimmyja. Neočekivano se mora posvetiti Archiejevoj kujici Fly, teško ozlijeđenoj nakon pada. Dok Archie spominje velikog psa lutalicu kojeg mještani zovu Barghest, James u Skeldaleu otkriva da Fly pati od artritisa i da će njezinu ulogu morati preuzeti mlađi ovčarski pas Lad. Tristan se vraća iz Italije i nalazi Skeldale u rasulu, a James mu otkriva koliko je teško živjeti i raditi sa Siegfriedom. Zajedno kreću po jedinu osobu koja bi mogla pomoći - gospođu Hall. James i Helen sada žive u Heston Grangeu s djecom. Helen je zabrinuta za Skeldale, ali ne podržava Jamesov plan da sve popravi. Na terenu, usred potrage za Archiejevim stadom, James napokon kaže Siegfriedu što misli. Pitanje je - je li kasno da se Siegfried sabere?

programme.title: Gospođica Marple, serija
programme.desc: Gospođica Marple prati ledi Virginiju Revel na raskošnu zabavu u njezin obiteljski dom, dvorac Chimneys, koji je bio okupljalište diplomata sve do krađe rijetkog dijamanta prije dvadeset godina. Do kraja vikenda Virginia mora odlučiti hoće li prihvatiti bračnu ponudu krutog političara Georgea Lomaxa ili će slijediti svoje srce i poći za zanimljivim udvaračem Anthonyjem Cadeom. Kratko prije potpisivanja ugovora o kupoprodaji imanja u tajnom prolazu unutar zidova dvorca njegov je kupac pronađen mrtav. Iz Scotland Yarda ubrzo stiže viši inspektor Battle koji svesrdno prihvati pomoć gđice Marple. Kad nađu kosti davno preminulog sluge, postaje jasno da je tajna dvorca Chimneysa mnogo mračnija negoli se ikad činilo.

programme.title: Kraljica zmija, serija
programme.desc: Kralj Henrik predvodi vojsku za obranu Francuske i postavlja Katarinu za regenticu, dopuštajući joj da dodatno iskuša svoje moći. Katarina traži od Rahime da pretraži Marijinu sobu da nađe pismo.

programme.desc: Dok Valmontova misija mijenja njegove osjećaje prema Camille, ona ulaže ekstremne napore kako bi osigurala svoju budućnost.

programme.title: Obitelj Hardacre, serija
programme.desc: Obiteljska saga o putu od siromaštva do bogatstva. Serija prati živote, ljubavi i uspon radničke obitelji Hardacre, koja se 90-ih godina 19. stoljeća seli iz prljavog ribarskog pristaništa na golemo seosko imanje u Yorkshireu. Nakon što zbog nesreće ostanu bez posla i novca, Hardacreovi dolaze na revolucionarnu poslovnu ideju i ubrzo stječu bogatstvo. Strelovito se uspinju na društvenoj ljestvici te suočavaju sa neprihvaćanjem kako aristokrata tako i služinčadi. Obitelj će na teži način naučiti da gospodu ne čini podrijetlo, nego njihova djela. ------- Kad zbog njegovog hrabrog čina Sam i ostatak obitelji Hardacre ostanu bez posla na dokovima, njegova žena Mary smisli riskantan poslovni plan kako bi nešto zaradili. Nije mogla ni zamisliti da će ih to izvući iz neimaštine i sirotinjskog naselja na obali North Yorkshirea te katapultirati u visoko društvo.

programme.title: Detektiv Murdoch, serija
programme.desc: U 13. sezoni ova vrhunska i međunarodno cijenjena serija slavi okrugli dvjestoti nastavak i dalje prateći privatni i profesionalni život detektiva Williama Murdocha (Yannick Bisson), dr. Julije Ogden (Hélène Joy), inspektora Thomasa Brackenreida (Thomas Craig), pozornika Georgea Crabtreeja (Jonny Harris) i Henryja Higgins-Newsomea (Lachlan Murdoch) te detektiva Llewelyna Wattsa (Daniel Maslany) dok se hvataju ukoštac s najvećim zagonetkama Toronta, od ozbiljnih i povijesnih, do komičnih i neobičnih. Murdoch i dalje zadivljuje vještom detekcijom koju mu olakšavaju brojne inovacije i izumi, poput naprave koja mjeri crte lica i uspoređuje ih s postojećim policijskim dosjeima. Nažalost, njegova sumnja u način na koji je Violet Hart (Shanice Banton) postala mrtvozornica i nepovjerenje u njezine motive i dalje izaziva sukobe. Naoružana ambicijom ona bi mogla biti doista gadna neprijateljica Murdochu i dr. Ogden. Kao pojačanje u postaju dolazi i specijalni pozornik Robert Parker (Marc Senior), Afroamerikanac i bivši Pinkertonov detektiv koji se prvi put pojavio kao sumnjivac u slučaju ubojstva sindikalista da bi na kraju pomogao u rješavanju zločina. --- Murdoch istražuje eksploziju na skupu sufražetkinja na kojemu su sudjelovale dr. Talbot (Claire Goose) i Julia, koja rezultira smrću jednog čovjeka.

programme.title: Detektiv Murdoch, serija
programme.desc: Tijekom sindikalnih prosvjeda u luci, jedan je radnik ubijen. Murdoch traži Roberta Parkera (M. Senior), neuhvatljiva tipa koji je možda vidio pucnjavu. programme.title: Gospođica Marple, serija
programme.desc: Gospođica Marple zatraži pomoć starog prijatelja sira Henryja Clitheringa u rješavanju zagonetnog slučaja ubojstva prozvanog Plavi geranij. Priča započinje nekoliko mjeseci ranije u selu Little Ambrose u kojem imućna i omražena Mary Pritchard umre od šoka nakon što geranij na njezinoj zidnoj tapeti neočekivano poplavi. Gospođica Marple u posjetu je svojem prijatelju vlč. Milewateru i odmah primijeti tenzije među mještanima. Misterij se produbi pronalaskom još jednog trupla pa se gospođica Marple požuri složiti slagalicu kako bi spriječila veliku nepravdu.

programme.title: Robin Hood, serija
programme.desc: Marian otkriva Robov identitet i prekida njihovu vezu. Princ John ulazi u priču s kraljevskim ambicijama dok se Marian nađe uvučena u opasnu romansu i smrtonosnu špijunsku igru ​​na dvoru.

programme.title: Detektiv Murdoch, serija
programme.desc: U 13. sezoni ova vrhunska i međunarodno cijenjena serija slavi okrugli dvjestoti nastavak i dalje prateći privatni i profesionalni život detektiva Williama Murdocha (Yannick Bisson), dr. Julije Ogden (Hélène Joy), inspektora Thomasa Brackenreida (Thomas Craig), pozornika Georgea Crabtreeja (Jonny Harris) i Henryja Higgins-Newsomea (Lachlan Murdoch) te detektiva Llewelyna Wattsa (Daniel Maslany) dok se hvataju ukoštac s najvećim zagonetkama Toronta, od ozbiljnih i povijesnih, do komičnih i neobičnih. Murdoch i dalje zadivljuje vještom detekcijom koju mu olakšavaju brojne inovacije i izumi, poput naprave koja mjeri crte lica i uspoređuje ih s postojećim policijskim dosjeima. Nažalost, njegova sumnja u način na koji je Violet Hart (Shanice Banton) postala mrtvozornica i nepovjerenje u njezine motive i dalje izaziva sukobe. Naoružana ambicijom ona bi mogla biti doista gadna neprijateljica Murdochu i dr. Ogden. Kao pojačanje u postaju dolazi i specijalni pozornik Robert Parker (Marc Senior), Afroamerikanac i bivši Pinkertonov detektiv koji se prvi put pojavio kao sumnjivac u slučaju ubojstva sindikalista da bi na kraju pomogao u rješavanju zločina. --- Murdoch istražuje eksploziju na skupu sufražetkinja na kojemu su sudjelovale dr. Talbot (Claire Goose) i Julia, koja rezultira smrću jednog čovjeka.

programme.title: Sva stvorenja velika i mala, serija
programme.desc: Hvaljena adaptacija omiljene i kultne zbirke priča autora bestselera Jamesa Herriota, u produkciji Playgrounda, nagrađena BAFTA-om i Zlatnim globusom, vraća se na male ekrane. I ova će sezona nastaviti oživljavati priče Jamesa Herriota. Vraćamo se u Darrowby kako bismo se ponovno pridružili našoj nekonvencionalnoj, omiljenoj obitelji u Skeldaleu te šarolikom društvu farmera, životinja i stanovnika jorkširskih dolina 1940-ih godina.

programme.title: Obitelj Hardacre, serija
programme.desc: Uzbuđena što započinje novi život, obitelj se useljava u grandioznu kuću i uskoro upoznaje svoje susjede aristokratskog podrijetla. No dok se Mary sprema prirediti prvu večeru, postaje jasno da se neki članovi obitelji teško mire sa svojim novim statusom.

programme.title: Sva stvorenja velika i mala, serija
programme.desc: Herriotovi i Aldersonovi uživaju u životu na farmi u Hestonu, a konjska obitelj dobije novog člana kad Joan rodi ždrijebe. Helen je oduševljena vijestima, no ubrzo shvaća da se ni ona ni Jenny nisu spremne na promjene. Gospođa Hall traži nekoliko dana slobodno za proslavu unukina rođendana, što Siegfrieda baca u paniku. Gospođa Stokes dovede problematičnu kozu Hildu, a Tristanova romansa s Charlotte cvjeta, no nervozan je pred svečani ručak s njezinim ocem. Na farmi Stokesovih Siegfried se mora nositi s Hildom i pritom nauči ponešto o sebi, dok Helen, Jenny i Richard planiraju budućnost i Jenny dobije sjajnu ideju. James je zabrinut zbog financija ordinacije i preuzima dežurstvo na psećoj trkaćoj stazi u Hensfieldu. Tristan posjeti gospođu Ainsley i njenog agresivnog papagaja Georgea, koji ubrzo utječe na njegov privatni život. James sumnja da nešto nije u redu na trkalištu, Maggie otkriva talent gospođe Hall, a Siegfried uživa provoditi vrijeme s Jimmyjem - sve dok ne sazna neugodne istine o sebi.

programme.title: Gospođica Marple, serija
programme.desc: Razbijeno ogledalo priča je o holivudskoj zvijezdi Marini Gregg koja je visoke palme i blještava svjetla Los Angelesa zamijenila slikovitim krajolikom mjestašca St. Mary Mead u Engleskoj. Nastanila se u Gossington Hallu s naočitim mladim mužem, filmskim redateljem Jasonom Ruddom, njegovom tajnicom Ellom Blunt i svojim osobnim pomoćnikom Haileyjem Prestonom. Kad glamurozni par odluči prirediti zabavu, posjed okupiraju znatiželjni mještani uključujući i bivšu vlasnicu Gossington Halla Dolly Bantry (Joanna Lumley). No kad obožavateljica Heather Badcock popije otrovani koktel, Marina postaje zvijezda stvarne kriminalističke priče u čijoj je sporednoj ulozi i gospođica Marple.

programme.desc: E-misija je serijal posvećen inovacijama, održivim rešenjima i promenama koje oblikuju savremeni svet. Kroz aktuelne teme i inspirativne priče, emisija istražuje tehnologije koje menjaju našu svakodnevicu - od pametne poljoprivrede i zelenog transporta, do energije budućnosti i malih navika koje menjaju naše okruženje. programme.desc: Bare Knuckle Boxing (BKB) is the first and only licensed bare knuckle boxing company in the world. They hold the only established British and World Championship titles in 8 weight divisions.

programme.title: Fighting Rookies
programme.desc: Fighting Rookies is a competition with a unique chance for a kickboxer to clim the ladder of success in his sport. The Rookies compete for a chance to become professionals and get the experience needed to succeed at the highest level. Each fighter gives his best to turn his dream into reality. What they do today builds their future and echoes into eternity!

programme.title: King of Kings: KOK'69 World Series, Vilnius, Lithuania, 16.03.2019 - part I
programme.desc: King of Kings, one of the most recognizable brands in the world of kickboxing, returns to live action on FightBox HD. KOK brings the most dedicated fans to the biggest arenas in the world to create an amazing spectacle.

programme.title: Underground Boxing Night: Poland 2023 - Part 2
programme.desc: Underground Boxing Night is a gala that will delight all fans of fist fighting. In the 4x4 meter arena you will see unforgettable boxing fights, where sport and emotions combine in a unique way. Now, only with us, you can secure a place at one of the most exciting boxing galas.

programme.title: Colosseum Tournament: Bucharest
programme.desc: An exceptional show of sound and lights, kickboxing and MMA gala, in which we will have fighters from Romania and beyond. A gala where heroes of martial arts from Romania will meet some of the strongest opponents.

programme.title: ECE Enfusion Xtreme Standup: Alkmaar, Netherlands 25.05.2024
programme.desc: Standup Enfusion is an organization promoting martial arts events, and Xtreme Standup is one of its flagship events. These galas feature thrilling fights in formats such as K-1 and MMA.

programme.title: Jiu-Jitsu: Abu Dhabi Grand Slam: Rio de Janeiro
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi Grand Slam _ Rio de Janeiro is part of the AJP World Ranking and Abu Dhabi World Professional Jiu-Jitsu Qualifying Series.

programme.title: WGP Kickboxing Brazil
programme.desc: WGP Kickboxing Brazil is the premier kickboxing promotion in Latin America. Promoted since 2011, endorsed by the Brazilian Kickboxing Confederation and WAKO PRO, the promotion organizes several professional kickboxing events with the best athletes of Latin America and of the world, coming from World's leading Kickboxing powers, such as the Netherlands, Russia, Morocco, etc.

programme.title: Fox Sports Africa Boxing: South Africa, 30.06.2022
programme.desc: ESPN Africa Boxing brings boxing fans a series of knockout events throughout the year. Fighters from all over the African continent are represented on the roster: Each event has 4 regular fights (4 to 8 rounds) and 2 WBA title fights (12 rounds). ESPN serves as the home of boxing in Africa and guarantees superb production quality as it promotes and produces ESPN Africa Boxing events throughout the African continent.

programme.title: Fit Centrum Fight MMA: Poland 2023 - Part 1
programme.desc: Fit Centrum Fight is a series of martial arts events organized by Fit Centrum in Koluszki. These events aim to promote combat sports such as MMA, K-1, Muay Thai, and boxing, as well as to foster community integration through exciting matches.

programme.title: A Bucket of Blood
programme.desc: A dim-witted busboy finds acclaim as an artist for a plaster-covered dead cat that is mistaken as a skillful statuette. The desire for more praise soon leads to an increasingly deadly series of works.

programme.title: Roaring Abyss
programme.desc: A sound journey accros the mountains, deserts and forests of Ethiopia and its cultural universe. Roaring Abyss will take you through an inedit collection of music recordings of unvaluable importance for the transmission and preservation of the African heritage.

programme.title: The Admiral Was a Lady
programme.desc: Ex-WAVE encounters four fun-loving, work-hating men, all of whom want to marry her.

programme.title: Quality Time
programme.desc: Five thirty-something men in as many separate segments struggle to grapple with the relentless absurdity of their respective existences.

programme.title: Fabiu
programme.desc: 80-year-old retiree Arthur lives in a modest council home in Vienna. For quite some time he has lovingly been caring for his seriously ill wife Martha, with only female nurses assisting him. As he finds Fabiu, the new male hungarian care worker, on his doorstep, his routine is broken. But soon the two men become closer and inside Arthur feelings of desire and suppressed longing start to rise.

programme.title: Seven Chances
programme.desc: A man learns he will inherit a fortune if he marries by 7 p.m. that same day.

programme.title: Bella Vista
programme.desc: A film about place and belonging.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Secret Police
programme.desc: Captain Drummond and his girlfriend want to marry but a hidden treasure in the house in which they want to celebrate their marriage is complicating the situation involving a series of deaths and an elusive murderer.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's a bloodthirsty plant, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Call the Mesquiteers
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers are forced to track down a train robbery ring after some of the gang hijack their truck for a getaway and the police conclude they are part of the gang, an identification which is just fine with the gang's nameless chief.

programme.title: People Are Funny
programme.desc: A comedy based on NBC's "People Are Funny" radio (and later television) program with Art Linkletter with a fictional story of how the program came to be on a national network from its humble beginning at a Nevada radio station. Jack Haley is a producer with only half-rights to the program while Ozzie Nelson and Helen Walker are the radio writers and supply the romance. Rudy Vallee, always able to burlesque himself intentional and, quite often, unintentional, is the owner of the sought-after sponsoring company. Frances Langford, as herself, sings "I'm in the Mood for Love" while the Vagabonds quartet (billed 12th and last) chimes in on "Angeline" and "The Old Square Dance is Back Again."

programme.title: The Navigator
programme.desc: The wealthy and impulsive Rollo Treadway decides to propose to his beautiful socialite neighbor, Betsy O'Brien. Although Betsy turns Rollo down, he still opts to go on the cruise that he intended as their honeymoon.

programme.title: Wake Me When the War Is Over
programme.desc: During the final months of WW2, a lonely German Baroness hides an attractive American airman in her mansion for long time without telling him the war has been over for almost five years.

programme.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
programme.desc: Swordsman-poet helps soldier woo the woman he loves.

programme.title: Mutiny
programme.desc: Early in the War of 1812, Captain James Marshall is commissioned to run the British blockade and fetch an unofficial war loan from France. As first mate, Marshall recruits Ben Waldridge, a cashiered former British Navy captain. Waldridge brings his former gun crew...who begin plotting mutiny as soon as they learn there'll be gold aboard. The gold duly arrives, and with it Waldridge's former sweetheart Leslie, who's fond of a bit of gold herself. Which side is Waldridge really on?

programme.title: Desert Storm
programme.desc: Chet Kasedon is after the Indians hidden gold mine but Chief Moya will not reveal it's location. He has also hired mining engineers Gale and Mortimer to locate the mine. When Gale sees Kasedon's cruelty to Moya, he switches sides.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Peril
programme.desc: Drummond's wedding with Phyllis is interrupted when the inspector guarding their gifts is killed. He tries to trace the killers and uncovers the mystery of diamond counterfeiters.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: The Sadist
programme.desc: Three people driving into Los Angeles for a Dodgers game have car trouble and pull off into an old wrecking yard where they are held at bay by a bloodthirsty psycho and his crazy girlfriend.

programme.title: Girl Gang
programme.desc: A sleazy gangster has a gang of young girls commit robberies and prostitution for him by getting them hooked on drugs.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.title: Game Show Dynamos
programme.desc: Bernard and Claire Boiko won enough money on TV game shows to escape debt and rebuild their lives, appearing on national television 28 times from the 1950s to the 1990s. Their daughter Patricia blends clips from 10 game shows with vintage footage, motion graphics, and music to create an intimate portrait of her quirky parents. Through love, hardship, ambition, and humor, the film captures a unique family story and a revealing slice of 20th-century life, culminating in Bernard's words: "If it's a lucky life, it's mine.

programme.title: Went the Day Well?
programme.desc: The quiet village of Bramley End is taken over by German troops posing as Royal Engineers. Their task is to disrupt England's radar network in preparation for a full scale German invasion. Once the villagers discover the true identity of the troops, they do whatever they can to thwart the Nazis plans.

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Paris
programme.desc: Love, marriage and heartache in paris after the war.

programme.title: The Stranger Within a Woman
programme.desc: Two friends meet in a bar. Later that night, one friend's flirtatious wife is reportedly in an accident. The other friend doesn't feel well. What's come over him?

programme.title: Sea Dragon
programme.desc: A young fossil hunter makes a groundbreaking discovery, challenging the worldview of 19th century England.

programme.title: The Murder in the Museum
programme.desc: When a city councilman is murdered while investigating allegations of drug dealing going on a a somewhat disreputable sideshow, the daughter of the chief suspect teams up with a newspaper reporter to find the real killer.

programme.title: A Farewell to Arms
programme.desc: A ravishing adaptation of Ernest Hemingway's legendary novel, A FAREWELL TO ARMS stars Gary Cooper as Lt. Frederic Henry, a young ambulance driver for the Italian army in WWI, more interested in chasing women than the enemy. When seeking cover during an air raid, he encounters Nurse Catherine Barkley, and the world shifts under his feet. They fall in love, but the war keeps wrenching them apart. These painful separations force Frederic to choose between love and battle, a decision that tests him morally and spiritually, and leads to one of the most rapturously romantic endings of all time.

programme.title: Road Gate
programme.desc: Rauan works at a parking lot in a prestigious residential area. Aidar passes him daily in his luxurious car. The auto belongs to his father, who works in the oil business. Rauan and Aidar are both determined to build their own lives themselves. They live in the same city, their paths cross in the same yard, but there is an abyss between them. They are separated by a toll-bar between wealth and poverty. One day Aidar and Rauan will clash and their worlds will clash. What will the results be..?

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: Buck Colins heads a group of local ranchers who are trying to prevent the railroad from completing its line through their property. Till now they have been able to charge tolls on herds passing through. Hoppy goes undercover to expose them.

programme.title: The Hoodlum
programme.desc: Vincent Lubeck is a vicious ex-convict. His criminal activities are despised by his family, but he uses and abuses them in the course of his crimes. Eventually his own brother must stand up to him

programme.title: Captain Calamity
programme.desc: A South Seas skipper fights off thieves and pirates who are after a lost treasure.

programme.title: The Light of Western Stars
programme.desc: Due to a bet drunk Gene almost forces Majesty to marry him, then escapes after brawling with sheriff Tom. Majesty buys a ranch, needs Gene's help and finds him in a drunken stupor in Mexico. He vows to stay sober and fights crooked Tom.

programme.title: The Amazing Adventure
programme.desc: A bored millionaire wagers his doctor that he can support himself at a working class job for year without touching his inheritance.

programme.title: Santa Fe Marshall
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Hopalong Cassidy is called when a town becomes overrun with bad guys. Disguised as a member of a medicine show, Hoppy discovers that the ringleader is none other than sweet li'l ol' Ma Burton.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: When an only child is struck by a car and dies, the child's mother seeks vengeance against the driver in this thrilling drama. The car was driven by the wife of a company president who is having an affair. The woman's husband manages to buy silence about the incident, but the victim's mother discovers the identity of the driver. After she secures a job in the home of the company president and his philandering spouse, the woman plans to murder the couple's son when he reaches the age of her late son.

programme.title: Horse Tales
programme.desc: Horse Tales tells the story of stable boys, adolescents making a living by taking care of horses. In order to do so, it focuses on their job and their relationships with the animals they care for.

programme.title: A Midsummer Night's Dance
programme.desc: This is a wonderful story of a matchmaking event in Italy. Young men and women are escorted to a midsummer dance. There is a man who coordinates the proper arrangements and the mountain villages send their youth.

programme.title: Voyage to the Prehistoric Planet
programme.desc: In 2020, after the colonization of the moon, the spaceships Vega, Sirius and Capella are launched from Lunar Station 7.

programme.title: Manos: The Hands of Fate
programme.desc: A family gets lost on the road and stumbles upon a hidden, underground, devil-worshiping cult led by the fearsome Master and his servant Torgo.

programme.title: The Driver's Seat
programme.desc: Lise, a mentally unbalanced middle-aged woman, travels from her home in Copenhagen to Rome, Italy where she embarks on a fatal destiny, a premeditated search for someone, anyone, with whom she can form a dangerous liaison.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
programme.desc: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental lord who oversees the trust.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island
programme.desc: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.

programme.title: Joan of Arkansas
programme.desc: When the U.S. Space program requires an ordinary person to become the first human in space, the Saraback Computer chooses Joan Jones, a scatter brained, good natured klutz who works as a dental technician.

programme.title: Lukas the Strange
programme.desc: Lukas Nino (Lukas the Strange) follows an awkward teenager facing his initiation into manhood as a film crew descends on his village. After being told his father is a tikbalang—half horse, half man—Lukas begins to question his own nature when his father disappears. As the village is swept up in movie fever, a legend emerges about a mystical river that erases painful memories. Narrated by Lukas' friend Lorena, the film blends myth, coming-of-age, and imagination.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: A man in a gleaming white suit comes to a small Southern town on the eve of integration. He calls himself a social reformer. But what he does is stir up trouble--trouble he soon finds he can't control.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Newly married Kay Dunstan announces that she and her husband are having a baby, leaving her father to come to grips with the fact that he will soon be a granddad.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: People We Know Are Confused
programme.desc: Set in Vilnius, a modern city still in search for its relation to the past, three parallel stories with three average people marooned in a state of change, looking to the future with hope, but not letting go of constricting and reassuring fears of their past.

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: It's a Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

programme.title: 30 Years and an Ocean in Between
programme.desc: Jaume, who was once a passionate young man, has become a disillusioned middle-aged man who has lost his desire to write and can't remember the last time he fell in love. On another boring summer day in Barcelona, he receives a surprise visit from Elisabeth, a romantic interest from the past. The encounter brings back the Jaume of yesterday, turning his monotonous life upside down.

programme.title: AUN: The Beginning and the End of All Things
programme.desc: When looking for alternative energy sources, the Japanese scientist Sekai tragically dies. Twenty years later the Brazilian mathematician Euclides continues his research. The lack of an essential component won't allow a breakthrough. Only AUN, Sekai's son, seems to hold the key to protect mankind from self-destruction. In the aftermath of the nuclear tragedy in Fukushima the film appears like a prophecy. AUN's dream-like images, complemented by music from Christian Fennesz and Ryuichi Sakamoto, lead into a fantastic and exciting world, full of brightness and darkness of life.

programme.title: Pride of the West
programme.desc: Caldwell and Nixon have their men rob the stage and then critcize the Sheriff for not catching the robbers. With her father the Sheriff under pressure, Mary sends for Hoppy who finds the stolen money and sets a trap to bring in the entire gang.

programme.title: The Railrodder
programme.desc: After reading an newspaper advertisement in the London Times about touring Canada, an elderly Englishman decides to do just that. Following his long walk across the Atlantic Ocean, Keaton travels along the Canadian National Railway tracks on a railway motorcar (speeder), performing a few stunts reminiscent of those in his younger days.

programme.title: Riff Raff
programme.desc: Vincent is an ex-criminal who more than anything, just wants a normal, peaceful life. He and his wife Sandy, have built a loving family with their son DJ and are spending their last summer in a cabin before he goes off to college. Chaos ensues when Vincent's disowned son Rocco, his girlfriend Marina, and Vincent's ex-wife Ruth abruptly show up to spoil the festivities with an ominous warning: famed gangsters Leftie and Lonnie are coming for them.

programme.title: Imaginary Heroes
programme.desc: A shocking and tragic event causes the members of a quietly dysfunctional family to reexamine themselves and their lives in this drama. Ben and Sandy Travis (Jeff Daniels and Sigourney Weaver) are a couple whose troubled family begins to crumble when their eldest son, star college athlete Matt (Kip Pardue) commits suicide. Sandy's naturally cynical nature becomes all the more prickly, and while she tries to bond with her surviving teenaged son, Tim (Emile Hirsch), they seem closest when they discover a shared fondness for marijuana. Ben also tries to reach out to Tim, but the young man is never able to shake the feeling that he's never quite been the son his father wanted. Tim has a girlfriend, Steph (Suzanne Santo), but their relationship has been going through a rocky patch, and Tim finds himself questioning his feelings about women and men when his friendship with next-door neighbor Kyle (Ryan Donowho) evolves into something more intimate.

programme.title: Hell House LLC Origins: The Carmichael Manor
Rain
programme.desc: A German Shepard named Rain is trained to fight in the Vietnam War and his intelligence and courage in the face of adversity wins the respect and loyalty of his platoon.

programme.title: Whisper Island
programme.desc: Sam Dalton, a 14-year-old girl, is determined to save the only home she has ever known, the faded, dusty Romanian Princess ranch. Sam writes to a distant relative of her Aunt Christine hoping he can prevent the ranch from being repossessed. But it's J. T. Swinton, a teenage boy who shows up. In desperation they turn to a seemingly futile hope, the treasure of Whisper Island. But does the Civil War treasure really exist? The answer seems to be trapped somewhere in the wishful delusions of Aunt Christine. As the teens search for treasure in a race against time, they must also search Christine's past and unravel a web of romance, intrigue and betrayal that spans a lifetime and beyond. What they find, changes their lives forever.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: An updated version of the 1980 musical, which centered on the students of the New York Academy of Performing Arts.

programme.title: Little Crumb: Race To the Gold Mine
programme.desc: Little Crumb is finally reunited with his parents, and now he is no longer a street urchin. He enjoys a splendid villa with his Mom and Dad. His days are peaceful and calm, and boring, as he does not have the excitement and adventures he is used to while living in a big city. He decides to run away and take his dog with him. Anna tries to stop him, but they are both kidnapped by the old enemy of the family. Now he has to use tall the skills and lifehacks of his new and his old life to escape and save his family.

programme.title: First Dog
programme.desc: A foster boy is befriended by a lost dog who turns out to belong to the President of the United States. The boy decides to run away from the foster home to return the canine to the White House -- "Because it's the right thing to do!"

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Death Defying Acts
programme.desc: On a tour of Britain in 1926, Harry Houdini enters into a passionate affair with a psychic out to con the famous magician.

programme.title: Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: In 2008, rookie journalist Jay Bahadur forms a half-baked plan to embed himself among the pirates of Somalia. He ultimately succeeds in providing the first close-up look into who these men are, how they live, and the forces that drive them.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: People You May Know follows Jed, a 30-something introvert who has managed to abstain from social media until now. When prompted with the gargantuan task of defining who he is, he realizes the life he can fake is much more interesting than the life he actually leads.

programme.title: Digging Into China
programme.desc: Harriet, a ten-year old girl, lives together with her big sister and her alcoholic mother out in the countryside. The family runs a motel. Harriet is different from the others, as she owns a great creativity and has nobody to play with. Her infinite world exists only in her mind. One day, Ricky comes along. He is a grown-up, but retarded son of an elderly lady. Soon, Harriet and Ricky share their experiences of life from a different point of view and become close friends. But his mother still plans to give Ricky away into professional care in a home, because she won't live forever to be there for him.

programme.title: Risen
programme.desc: The Rise of a True British Champion. Based on a true story. As a young man, Howard Winstone was one of the biggest rising talents in amateur boxing. Already with a number of schoolboy titles under his belt, the boy from Merthyr Tydfil, Wales, was fast making a name for himself with his knockout right hand. A career as a professional fighter beckoned. Being from a poor family and struggling to make ends meet, Howard helped out by working weekends in a toy factory. And it was there his dream effectively came to an end as a metal pressing machine malfunctioned and crushed Howard's fingers, injuring his right hand so severely he had to undergo amputation. He lost the tips of three fingers so his right hand could no longer make a proper fist. A depressed Howard seemingly lost everything. But his father wouldn't let him gripe and soon got him punching a coal bag to keep his spirits up. Then, under the guidance of a new trainer, Eddie Thomas, and with the support of his father, he started to learn a new style and once again began to rise up victoriously through the amateur ranks. By the time of his first professional fight, Howard had completely changed the way he boxed. Remarkably, he went on to become Champion of Britain and Champion of Europe. As with any person who achieves great things there is also a cost and Howard's was that of his marriage. At 16 he wed his childhood sweetheart, Bennita, who stood by him and had four beautiful children. But when pressures got too much for both of them the relationship came to a dramatic end. The dramatic finale culminates with Howard exceeding the hopes of an entire nation and being crowned Featherweight Champion of The World.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: Chef Carl Casper runs the kitchen of a thriving Los Angeles restaurant. Before the arrival of a leading restaurant critic, Carl wants to experiment with a new menu, but the commercial restaurant owner will not allow that. The result is a devastating review.

programme.title: Trattoria
programme.desc: This funny and heartwarming dramedy set in the exciting San Francisco culinary scene follows Sal Sartini, a workaholic chef who must learn to rekindle his passion for cooking and love, and repair the bond he has with his son before he risks losing everything again.

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: The story of a young orphaned boy who is sent to live with his grandfather in Ireland. The boy finds adjusting to the country life challenging, but soon learns the life has its rewards as well.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: Here is a surgeon. He can't practice medicine anymore because he has panic attacks, while reliving a surgery gone bad. His wife is a medical malpractice attorney who picks up a case from a woman who was her husband's nurse.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
The Ambassador to Bern
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival.

programme.title: Na sprovodu
programme.desc: Kad sve krene naopako za neobičnu Karis Rajtman, ona radi ono što bi učinila svaka emotivno izolovana, moderna devojka _ počinje da posećuje sahrane nepoznatih ljudi. Na jednoj sudbonosnoj sahrani upoznaje Tajlera, čoveka kome je umrla verenica. Uprkos upozorenjima grobara Šejna, njenog najboljeg prijatelja, kao i cimerke Lile, prvi put uspeva da ostvari nekakvu vezu. Tragajući za odgovorima, Karis odlazi kod svoje otuđene majke kako bi se suočila s prošlošću.

programme.title: Đavolje trojstvo
programme.desc: U burnoj Montani 1870-ih, osuđenik Ajzak Brodvej pred pogubljenje poverava otuđenom sinu Henriju nemoguć zadatak: da ubije čoveka koji ga je lažno optužio. Henrijeva potraga vodi ga u zabačeni gradić Triniti, gde se nalazi između pravednog šerifa Gabrijela Dava i tajanstvenog stranca po imenu Sent Kristofer.

programme.title: Fatalni izgled
programme.desc: Priča o tinejdžeru koji se nosi s manama i prednostima svoje smrtonosne privlačnosti.

programme.title: Igra žrtvovanja
programme.desc: Kao da već nije dovoljno loše to što učenice internata, Samanta i Klara, ne mogu da odu kući za praznike, situacija se dodatno komplikuje kada se na njihovim vratima pojavi banda ubica baš u vreme Božića.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Skor: Mjuzikl na ledu
programme.desc: Sedamnaestogodišnji Farli je vodio bezbedan život: školovan kod kuće, jeo organsku hranu i posećivao umetničke galerije. Na zaprepašćenje svojih roditelja, Farli voli da igra hokej sa decom iz komšiluka. Stvar je dodatno zakomplikovana kada ga primeti vlasnik omladinskog tima, koji ga odmah uzima pod svoje i on postaje zvezda. Ali brzo otkriva da slava ima cenu, uključujući i očekivanje da se bori na ledu. Kad se tome doda kvarenje odnosa s najboljim prijateljem, Farli shvata da ništa ne ide kako bi trebalo.

programme.title: Nas dvojica
programme.desc: Žan Hristian Ranu (Daniel Auteuil) je malo ekscentričan knjigovođa koji živi dan za danom. Žil Gabriel (Alain Chabat) je pop pevač koji je već imao svojih pet minuta slave. Niko ne bi ni pomislio da živote ta dva potpuno različita muškarca mogu da se povežu. Pop zvezda se sprema za svoj veliki povratak na scenu. Ipak, njegovi planovi se remete kada ga Ranu udari kolima. Kad Ranu dolazi sebi, otkriva da u glavi ima neki drugi glas. Uspostavlja se da je Gabrijel preminuo i nekako ušao u telo knjigovođe. Od tog trenutka, Ranu postaje dve osobe u jednom telu…

programme.title: Pas Timber - Lovac na blago
programme.desc: Dečak i njegov najbolji prijatelj (preslatki pas koji govori), daju sve od sebe da sačuvaju svoj dom i porodicu.

programme.title: Družina iz šugar krika: Riba velika kao kanu
programme.desc: Odmor Bila Kolinsa jednog po podneva u Šugar Kriku pretvara se u mnogo više od toga kada Poetri nabasa na nekog sakrivenog u močvari.

programme.title: Gvido superstar: Gvidov uspon
programme.desc: U ovoj urnebesnoj akcionoj komediji italijanski doseljenik upada u svet narko-bosova, superautomobila i tajnih agenata. Nakon što je izgubio posao u kompaniji Disko Valet zbog neumesnog junaštva, Gvido mora za FBI da izigrava sicilijanskog gangstera kako bi se infiltrirao u moćnu azijsku bandu. Stvari kreću naopako i postaju sve gore. Gvido to mora da ispravi pre nego što ga otkriju i ubiju ili, još gore, deportuju.

programme.title: Kancelarija na ćošku
programme.desc: U ovoj komediji o kancelarijskom životu, savesni službenik Orson pronalazi utočište u praznoj kancelariji, daleko od napornih kolega. Međutim, njegov neobičan izbor izaziva neočekivano negodovanje i pokreće niz apsurdnih događaja.

programme.title: Ponovo pisati
programme.desc: Oskarom nagrađeni pisac, koji je zapao u krizu, napušta Holivud i odlazi na Istočnu obalu da predaje pisanje scenarija na fakultetu. Tu se zaljubljuje u samohranu majku, studentkinju tog fakulteta.

programme.title: Obućar
programme.desc: "Kobler" govori o obućaru, četvrtoj generaciji u porodičnom poslu, koji pronalazi magičnu šivaću mašinu u podrumu svog oca. Mašina mu omogućava da živi živote svih ljudi koji nose njegove cipele.

programme.title: Poslednji ples
programme.desc: Nakon tragedije, poznata plesna kompanija iz Njujorka nalazi se na ivici kolapsa. Iako su napustili svet plesa zauvek, Travis, Krisa i Maks imaju poslednju šansu da ponovo pronađu strast i dokažu da čuda zaista mogu da se dogode.

programme.title: 50 prvih sastanaka
programme.desc: Henri Rot je muškarac koji beži od vezivanja, sve dok ne upozna prelepu Lusi. Njih dvoje odmah pronalaze zajednički jezik i Henri misli da je konačno pronašao devojku svojih snova... sve dok ne otkrije da ona pati od gubitka kratkoročnog pamćenja i da ga već sledećeg dana neće poznavati.

programme.title: Na kraju sveta
programme.desc: Saravak, na severoistoku ostrva Borneo, 1839. godine. Gotovo sasvim slučajno, sultan od Bruneja postavlja britanskog avanturistu Džejmsa Bruka na poziciju radže. Kao nezavistan vladar kreće u lični krstaški pohod protiv pirata, ropstva i lova na glave, dok istovremeno pokušava da obuzda zlonamerne ekspanzionističke ambicije Britanske imperije.

programme.title: Usponi i padovi
programme.desc: Neočekivano prijateljstvo rađa se između neuspešnog stendap komičara iz Los Anđelesa, koji je prinuđen da se pognute glave vrati kući na Long Ajlend, i tragično nesavršenog, ali šarmantnog i harizmatičnog dermatologa alkoholičara. Otkrivajući da su srodne duše, jedan drugom pomažu da pronađu isceljenje i samopouzdanje da se suoče sa neuspesima u svojim životima.

programme.title: Usponi i padovi
programme.desc: Neočekivano prijateljstvo rađa se između neuspešnog stendap komičara iz Los Anđelesa, koji je prinuđen da se pognute glave vrati kući na Long Ajlend, i tragično nesavršenog, ali šarmantnog i harizmatičnog dermatologa alkoholičara. Otkrivajući da su srodne duše, jedan drugom pomažu da pronađu isceljenje i samopouzdanje da se suoče sa neuspesima u svojim životima.

programme.title: Gospođica niko i ništa
programme.desc: Sara Jane je nesrećna u ljubavi, živi sa svojom ekscentričnom majkom i radi u firmi Judge Pharmaceuticals kao sekretarica bez ikakve perspektive za unapređenje. Iznenadno unapređenje na menadžersko mesto izgleda kao ono što je tražila. Ipak, zajedno s unapređenjem pojavljuje se novi svet, pun konkurencije od strane drugih poslovodja, spletki i komplikacija. Sara počinje da eliminiše konkurenciju na jedini način koji zna _ ubija. Na putu ka vrhu iznenada upoznaje muškarca svojih snova _ detektiva Billa Malloya, koji namerava da otkrije tajne smrti u Judge Pharmaceuticals.

programme.title: Odmazda
programme.desc: Ratni veteran pokušava da prikupi novac za lečenje svog sina tako što se sa još jednim veteranom udružuje u lovu na kriminalce.

programme.title: Izabrana porodica
programme.desc: En je instruktorka joge koja se trudi da postigne unutrašnji mir, uprkos tome što je njena porodica izluđuje, a ljubavni život joj je katastrofalan. Ne zna kako da kaže "ne" i želi da rešava tuđe probleme. U međuvremenu, pokušava da spase svoju sestru Klio od zavisnosti, što dovodi do katastrofalnih posledica. Pod pritiskom brojnih očekivanja, oslanja se na svoje dobre prijatelje Maksa, Frensis, Roz i Elu za podršku. Oni joj zauzvrat nameštaju simpatičnog razvedenog oca Stiva, koji ima preslatku sedmogodišnju ćerku. Kada upozna Stivovu ćerku Lili, En je odmah očarana, ali Lili ne oseća isto; što su Stiv i En bliži, to Lili postaje ljubomornija. Kad Lili počne loše da se ponaša, En shvata da u Stivovim očima ona ne može da pogreši, pa započinje bitku života sa sedmogodišnjakinjom.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Operacija "Panda"
programme.desc: Međunarodna akciona zvezda Džeki Čen pozvan je na ceremoniju usvajanja retkog mladunčeta pande. Ali kada međunarodni kriminalni sindikat pokuša da ga otme, Džeki mora da ga spase, oslanjajući se na svoje veštine i vratolomije koje su neizbežne u njegovim borilačkim filmovima.

programme.title: Ujak Nino
programme.desc: Otuđena i prilično disfunkcionalna porodica ponovo se zbližava, kada im iz Italije u Čikago u iznenadnu posetu dođe očev davno izgubljeni ujak Nino.

programme.title: Ted - izgubljeni pustolov
programme.desc: Avanturista u pokušaju, Tad Džons, traži izgubljeni grad u spektakularnoj 3D komediji koja će vas prošetati od amazonske džungle do planinskih vrhova Anda.

programme.title: Družina iz Šugar krika: Oživljavanje zločinaca
programme.desc: Dugo očekivani praznik Preobraženja u Šugar Kriku konačno je tu, ali jutro počinje veoma loše za neke od stanovnika. Družina očekuje večernje slavlje, a vreme prekraćuju kupanjem u potoku, sve dok se ne pojave siledžije. Nakon koškanja u potoku, Big Bob Til govori članovima družine da je slavlje u velikoj opasnosti. Odmah po dolasku, kreće potraga za dokazima.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Maraton
programme.desc: Mladi službenik Jusuf predlaže četvorici kolega iz firme da učestvuju na maratonu i pronalazi sponzora. Oni pristaju, pa Jusuf postaje njihov trener. Ispostavlja se da je čitav trening klatak cirkus. Fizičko stanje muškaraca, koji su pušači, pijandure, žderači slatkiša i kockari, zaista je užasno. Uz to, ni situacija kod kuće nije im baš zavidna, jer svako ima svoje probleme. Uprkos inspirativnim treninzima trenera Jusufa, oni naizgled ne mogu da prate njegov gust raspored. Prvi test, trka u Amsterdamu, pretvara se u katastrofu. Nakon Jusufove kritike, momci postaju uporni, pa čak i fanatični. Ipak, tokom priprema za maraton, postaje jasno da je ulog mnogo veći od spasavanja garaže, kako im je rečeno.

programme.title: Visina
programme.desc: Agentu FBI ponuđeni su milioni da pomogne lopovu da pobegne iz otetog aviona.

programme.title: Zaboravljeni
programme.desc: Džordž je mentalno oboleli beskućnik, koji već godinama nije u stanju da zadrži posao. On luta gradom tražeći hranu, alkohol i sklonište, ali sve vreme pokušava da ostvari kontakt sa svojom ćerkom. Džordž se obraća njujorškoj socijalnoj službi, ali mu za potrebnu finansijsku pomoć nedostaju dokumenta. Tada postaje prijatelj s drugim beskućnikom, koji tvrdi da je bio uspešni džez muzičar.

programme.title: Krvoproliće
programme.desc: Priča o srdačnom susretu četvoro roditelja, nakon tuče u školskom dvorištu između njihovih sinova.

programme.title: U troje sa žigolom
programme.desc: Fijoravante odlučuje da postane profesionalni Don Žuan kako bi zaradio novac i pomogao svom prijatelju Mariju, koji je ostao bez novca. Sa Marijem, koji postaje njegov "menadžer", ubrzo stiže na mesto gde se ukrštaju novac i ljubav.

programme.title: Slom
programme.desc: Policajka se sa ćerkom vraća u rodni grad da brine o teško bolesnoj majci. Međutim, ubistvo mlade sugrađanke otvara istragu koju zapravo niko ne želi da vodi, pa ona ostaje duže nego što je planirala kako bi otkrila istinu.

programme.title: Deveri
programme.desc: Mladoženja i njegova četvorica kumova suočavaju se s pitanjima sopstvenog prijateljstva i zrelosti nedelju dana pred venčanje.

programme.title: Deveri
programme.desc: Mladoženja i njegova četvorica kumova suočavaju se s pitanjima sopstvenog prijateljstva i zrelosti nedelju dana pred venčanje.

programme.title: Kvantna nadmoć
programme.desc: U budućnosti koju ugrožavaju odmetnuti roboti i svemoćna veštačka inteligencija, kapetan Monro i njegova posada vode trku s vremenom kako bi sprečili propast čovečanstva.

programme.title: Londonski bulevar
programme.desc: Priča o londonskom kriminalcu koji izlazi iz zatvora i započinje vezu s mladom povučenom glumicom.

programme.title: Tajna operacija
programme.desc: Šon Bin igra Juana, agenta tajne službe, infiltriranog duboko u podzemlje Londona, a na tragu opasnoj terorističkoj ćeliji. Njegova misija je da ćeliju uništi iz korena. U ostalim ulogama su Džejmi Foks i Šarlota Rampling kao njegovi operativci, a Abin Galeja igra opasnog Klinskina, prethodno neosuđivanog teroristu, nepoznatog Nacionalnoj bezbednosti i najgoru noćnu moru svakog agenta.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Izviđačka avantura
programme.desc: Film o odrastanju grupe dečaka i devojčica koji se vraćaju s kampovanja i shvataju da je njihov mali grad pod opsadom grupe prilično tupavih bajkera. Koristeći svoje izviđačko znanje, deca savladavaju članove bande, jednog po jednog.

programme.title: Penina senka
programme.desc: Tokom odmora na ostrvu Ejmland, devojka otkriva opasnog konja koji nema poverenja u ljude. Da bi dokazala da konj uopšte nije opasan, devojka ga potajno obučava kako bi ponovo stekao poverenje u ljude.

programme.title: Družina iz šugar krika: Tajno sklonište
programme.desc: Četvrti nastavak iz serijala "Družina iz Šugar Krika". Družina juri kroz močvaru, ali nailaze na prethodno neistraženu teritoriju, koja ih vodi usred misterije. Kao da to nije dosta, Poetrino jagnje izaziva haos u školi, pa su zbog njega svi u nevolji kod gđice Lili. Kad se sve smiri, družina planira da noć provede u pećini nadomak groblja, ali Tom Til otkriva tajnu koja će ih sve uzdrmati.

programme.title: Družina iz šugar krika: Pljačkaš iz močvare
programme.desc: Neočekivano otkriće tajne mape u močvari vodi Družinu iz Šugar Krika na ludo putovanje, avanturu u kojoj pokušavaju da nadmudre lopova u trci za skrivenim blagom.

programme.title: Projekat Dinosaur
programme.desc: Projekat "Dinosaurus" govori o ekspediciji oca i sina u Kongu, uz pratnju dokumentarističke TV ekipe. Kada svi akteri filma misteriozno nestanu, pronađeni snimak pokazaće zapanjujuće prizore dinosaurusa, za koje se verovalo da su izumrli pre 65 miliona godina.

programme.title: Deca špijuni: Sve vreme sveta
programme.desc: Novopečena penzionisana agentkinja Džesika Vilson pokušava da se prilagodi porodičnom životu, ali su joj kućni poslovi teži od bilo kakve misije. Kada porodična amajlija slučajno oslobodi opasnog Čuvara Vremena, Džesika se vraća u akciju, a deca Sesil i Rebeka, uz pomoć starih Špijunčića, postaju jedina nada za spas porodice i čitavog sveta.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Operacija "Morski vuk"
programme.desc: U poslednjim danima Drugog svetskog rata, Nemačka, očajna i u potrazi za poslednjom šansom da porazi saveznike, okuplja svoje preostale podmornice za završnu misiju: napad na kontinentalne Sjedinjene Države.

programme.title: Ljubav u oblacima
programme.desc: Novinarka Bruklin odlazi na Festival balona da upozna pilota Džareda, koji organizuje romantične letove, iako nije baš spreman za ljubav.

programme.title: Praktične devojke
programme.desc: Dve bogate sestre, naslednice porodičnog kozmetičkog carstva, suočavaju se sa surovom realnošću kada ih skandal i istraga ostave bez nasledstva.

programme.title: Uljez
programme.desc: Psihološki triler o mladom bračnom paru koji kupuje prelepu kuću u Dolini Napa, ali ubrzo shvata da bivši vlasnik odbija da se odrekne imanja.

programme.title: Ubistvena vrelina
programme.desc: Privatni detektiv koji živi u inostranstvu angažovan je da istraži sumnjivu smrt na Kritu, gde moćnu porodicu žrtve razdiru ljubomora i zavist.

programme.title: Na pogrešnom putu
programme.desc: Četvorica mladića upuštaju se u rizičnu investiciju, koja ih vodi u sukob s mafijom.

programme.title: Ekspres
programme.desc: Prati kriminalnu psihologinju Bárbáru i njenju porodicu nakon što postane žrtva jednog od najnovijih, viralno širenih oblika nasilnog zločina, brzih otmica.

programme.title: Ekspres
programme.desc: Prati kriminalnu psihologinju Bárbáru i njenju porodicu nakon što postane žrtva jednog od najnovijih, viralno širenih oblika nasilnog zločina, brzih otmica.

programme.title: Dobri komšija
programme.desc: Dvojica nestašnih srednjoškolaca uspešno uveravaju svog vremešnog komšiju da u njegovoj kući ima duhova. Međutim, niz nesrećnih okolnosti pretvara njihovu bezazlenu šalu u tragediju.

programme.title: U kandžama lopova
programme.desc: Kada Džejk, čuvar obezbeđenja u malom hotelu, nenamerno pomogne prelepoj pljačkašici, postaje glavni osumnjičeni i odmah ga otpuštaju. Džejk odlučuje da sam prati pljačkašicu i povrati ukradenu imovinu.

programme.title: Sumnja
programme.desc: Darel Džejkobs je penzionisani mafijaš koji živi u Finiksu. Kada oboli od raka, shvata da mu vreme ističe, pa svakodnevno posećuje svoj omiljeni kafić. Mlada konobarica Ališa Foret, studentkinja prava, zaintrigirana je tajanstvenim redovnim gostom, pa ga prati do kuće. Ubrzo započinje prijateljstvo koje Ališu dovodi u opasnost i primorava Darela da dovrši "nesvršena posla". Ališin momak Tom ne odobrava njihovo prijateljstvo, pa ih prati. Kada otkrije Darelov pravi identitet, Tom upada u paniku, ali ne zbog bezbednosti svoje devojke, već zbog sopstvene.
